        "contents": "const HomePage: React.FC = \n;\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 加载精选项目\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;&amp; featuredResponse.data) {\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载最近项目\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;&amp; recentResponse.data) {\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\"全部\"和\"我的项目\"标签，或强制加载时）\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100,\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\n        });\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;&amp; allResponse.data) {\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&gt; {\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\n    if (response.success) {\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\"我的项目\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\n      setActiveTab('my');\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\n      await loadProjects(true);\n    } else {\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&gt; {\n    // 更新最后打开时间\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\n    navigate(&#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project)\n;\n;",

{\n    const fetchData = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        setLoading(true)\n        const [carModelsResponse, techPointsResponse] = await Promise.all([\n          carModelService.getAll(),\n          techPointService.getTechPoints()\n        ])\n        \n        // 处理API响应格式\n        if (carModelsResponse.success &amp;&amp; carModelsResponse.data) {\n          setCarModels(Array.isArray(carModelsResponse.data) ? carModelsResponse.data : carModelsResponse.data.data || [])\n        }\n        \n        if (techPointsResponse.success &amp;&amp; techPointsResponse.data) {\n          setTechPoints(Array.isArray(techPointsResponse.data) ? techPointsResponse.data : techPointsResponse.data.data || [])\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : '获取数据失败')\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n\n    fetchData()\n  }, [])\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"app\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"loading\"&gt;加载中...&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    )\n  }\n\n  if (error) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"app\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"error\"&gt;错误: {error}&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"app\"&gt;\n      &lt;header className=\"app-header\"&gt;\n        &lt;h1&gt;TPD2 - 汽车推广管理系统&lt;/h1&gt;\n      &lt;/header&gt;\n      \n      &lt;main className=\"app-main\"&gt;\n        &lt;section className=\"section\"&gt;\n          &lt;h2&gt;车型列表 ({carModels.length})&lt;/h2&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"car-models-grid\"&gt;\n            {carModels.map((carModel) =&gt; (\n              &lt;div key={carModel.id} className=\"car-model-card\"&gt;\n                &lt;h3&gt;{carModel.name}&lt;/h3&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;品牌ID:&lt;/strong&gt; {carModel.brand_id}&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;上市年份:&lt;/strong&gt; {carModel.launch_year}&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;类别:&lt;/strong&gt; {carModel.category}&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;状态:&lt;/strong&gt; {carModel.status}&lt;/p&gt;\n                {carModel.end_year &amp;&amp; (\n                  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;停产年份:&lt;/strong&gt; {carModel.end_year}&lt;/p&gt;\n                )}\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            ))}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/section&gt;\n\n        &lt;section className=\"section\"&gt;\n          &lt;h2&gt;技术点列表 ({techPoints.length})&lt;/h2&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"tech-points-grid\"&gt;\n            {techPoints.map((techPoint) =&gt; (\n              &lt;div key={techPoint.id} className=\"tech-point-card\"&gt;\n                &lt;h3&gt;{techPoint.name}&lt;/h3&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;描述:&lt;/strong&gt; {techPoint.description}&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;技术类型:&lt;/strong&gt; {techPoint.tech_type}&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;优先级:&lt;/strong&gt; {techPoint.priority}&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;状态:&lt;/strong&gt; {techPoint.status}&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;分类ID:&lt;/strong&gt; {techPoint.category_id}&lt;/p&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            ))}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/section&gt;\n      &lt;/main&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  )\n}\n\nexport default App",
  "totalLinesInFile": 102
}

{\n  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);\n  const [editingTechPoint, setEditingTechPoint] = useState&lt;\n    TechPoint | undefined\n  &gt;();\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useState&lt;TechPointSearchParams&gt;({});\n\n  const {\n    techPoints,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    pagination,\n    fetchTechPoints,\n    createTechPoint,\n    updateTechPoint,\n    deleteTechPoint,\n    searchTechPoints,\n  } = useTechPoints();\n\n  // 初始加载数据\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    fetchTechPoints();\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  const handleCreateNew = () =&gt; {\n    setEditingTechPoint(undefined);\n    setShowForm(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleEdit = (techPoint: TechPoint) =&gt; {\n    setEditingTechPoint(techPoint);\n    setShowForm(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleFormSubmit = async (\n    formData: TechPointFormData,\n  ): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; =&gt; {\n    try {\n      if (editingTechPoint) {\n        await updateTechPoint(editingTechPoint.id, formData);\n      } else {\n        await createTechPoint(formData);\n      }\n\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"保存技术点失败:\", error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await deleteTechPoint(id);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"删除技术点失败:\", error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSearch = async (params: TechPointSearchParams) =&gt; {\n    setSearchParams(params);\n\n    // 如果搜索参数为空，则获取全部数据\n    const hasSearchParams = Object.values(params).some(\n      (value) =&gt; value !== undefined &amp;&amp; value !== \"\" &amp;&amp; value !== null,\n    );\n\n    if (hasSearchParams &amp;&amp; params.keyword) {\n      await searchTechPoints(params.keyword, params);\n    } else {\n      await fetchTechPoints();\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePageChange = async (page: number) =&gt; {\n    // 根据当前是否有搜索参数决定调用哪个方法\n    if (searchParams.keyword) {\n      await searchTechPoints(searchParams.keyword, { ...searchParams, page });\n    } else {\n      await fetchTechPoints({ page });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCloseForm = () =&gt;         "contents": "import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\nimport {\n  TechPoint,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n} from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\n */\nclass TPDTechPointService {\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\n      timeout: 30000,\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; {\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\n        if (response.data &amp;&amp; response.data.code === 200) {\n          return {\n            ...response,\n            data: {\n              success: true,\n              data: response.data.data,\n              message: response.data.message,\n            },\n          };\n        }\n        return response;\n      },\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 错误响应格式转换\n        if (error.response &amp;&amp; error.response.data) {\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\n          return Promise.reject({\n            ...error,\n            response: {\n              ...error.response,\n              data: {\n                success: false,\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\n                code: tpdError.code,\n              },\n            },\n          });\n        }\n        return Promise.reject(error);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import {\n  TechPoint,\n  TechCategory,\n  CarModel,\n  TechPointStats,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n  TechPointFormData,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { techPointService } from '../services/techPointService';\n\nexport const useTechPoints = () =&gt; {\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&lt;TechPoint[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({\n    total: 0,\n    page: 1,\n    pageSize: 20,\n    totalPages: 0\n  });\n\n  // 获取技术点列表\n  const fetchTechPoints = useCallback(async (params?: TechPointSearchParams) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints(params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data);\n        setPagination({\n          total: response.data.total,\n          page: response.data.page,\n          pageSize: response.data.pageSize,\n          totalPages: response.data.totalPages\n        });\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '获取技术点列表失败');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('获取技术点列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  // 创建技术点\n  const createTechPoint = useCallback(async (data: TechPointFormData) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.createTechPoint(data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '创建技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('创建技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 更新技术点\n  const updateTechPoint = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async getTechPoints(\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (responseData.success &amp;&amp; responseData.data) {\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\n        \n        return {\n          success: true,\n          data: {\n            data: dataArray,\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\n            total,\n            page,\n            pageSize,\n            totalPages,\n          },\n          message: responseData.message,\n        };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error:\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\n          error.message ||\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();",

        "contents": "export const useTechPoints = \n\n\n  // 更新技术点\n  const updateTechPoint = useCallback(async (id: number, data: Partial&lt;TechPointFormData&gt;) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.updateTechPoint(id, data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '更新技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('更新技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 删除技术点\n  const deleteTechPoint = useCallback(async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.deleteTechPoint(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '删除技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('删除技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 搜索技术点\n  const searchTechPoints = useCallback(async (keyword: string, params?: Omit&lt;TechPointSearchParams, 'keyword'&gt;) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.searchTechPoints(keyword, params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data);\n        setPagination({\n          total: response.data.total,\n          page: response.data.page,\n          pageSize: response.data.pageSize,\n          totalPages: response.data.totalPages\n        });\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '搜索技术点失败');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('搜索技术点失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  return {\n    techPoints,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    pagination,\n;",

        "contents": "import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\nimport {\n  TechPoint,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n} from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\n */\nclass TPDTechPointService {\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\n      timeout: 30000,\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; {\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\n        if (response.data &amp;&amp; response.data.code === 200) {\n          return {\n            ...response,\n            data: {\n              success: true,\n              data: response.data.data,\n              message: response.data.message,\n            },\n          };\n        }\n        return response;\n      },\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 错误响应格式转换\n        if (error.response &amp;&amp; error.response.data) {\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\n          return Promise.reject({\n            ...error,\n            response: {\n              ...error.response,\n              data: {\n                success: false,\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\n                code: tpdError.code,\n              },\n            },\n          });\n        }\n        return Promise.reject(error);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport {\n  KnowledgePoint,\n  CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  KnowledgePointQueryOptions,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/knowledgePoint';\n\nconst KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL = '/knowledge-points';\n\nexport const knowledgePointService = {\n  // 创建知识点\n  async create(data: CreateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post(KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options?: KnowledgePointQueryOptions\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const params = {\n      page: options?.page || 1,\n      pageSize: options?.pageSize || 10,\n      orderBy: options?.orderBy || 'created_at',\n      orderDirection: options?.orderDirection || 'DESC'\n    };\n    \n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/tech-point/${techPointId}&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点详情\n  async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\nasync (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 推广策略\n  promotionStrategy: async (techStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('promotionStrategy');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = {\n        inputs: { techStrategy },\n      };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/promotion-strategy\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Promotion strategy API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术通稿\n  coreDraft: async (promotionStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('coreDraft');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = {\n        inputs: { promotionStrategy },\n      };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/core-draft\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Core draft API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 发布会演讲稿\n  speechGeneration:\n,\n};",

        "contents": "class TPDTechPointService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\n   */\n  async getTechPoints(\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\n      const queryParams: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n\n      if (params?.page) {\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.keyword) {\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\n      }\n      if (params?.category_id) {\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.status) {\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\n      }\n      if (params?.type) {\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\n      }\n      if (params?.priority) {\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\n      }\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\n      }\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\n      }\n\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\n        params: queryParams,\n      });\n\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\n      const responseData = response.data;\n\n      if (responseData.success &amp;&amp; responseData.data)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import {\n  TechPoint,\n  TechCategory,\n  CarModel,\n  TechPointStats,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n  TechPointFormData,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { techPointService } from '../services/techPointService';\n\nexport const useTechPoints = () =&gt; {\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&lt;TechPoint[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({\n    total: 0,\n    page: 1,\n    pageSize: 20,\n    totalPages: 0\n  });\n\n  // 获取技术点列表\n  const fetchTechPoints = useCallback(async (params?: TechPointSearchParams) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints(params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data);\n        setPagination({\n          total: response.data.total,\n          page: response.data.page,\n          pageSize: response.data.pageSize,\n          totalPages: response.data.totalPages\n        });\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '获取技术点列表失败');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('获取技术点列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  // 创建技术点\n  const createTechPoint = useCallback(async (data: TechPointFormData) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.createTechPoint(data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '创建技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('创建技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 更新技术点\n  const updateTechPoint = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "import type { ApiResponse, ApiErrorPayload } from '@/shared/types/api';\n\nclass ApiClient {\n  private readonly client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1',\n      timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.request.use((config) =&gt; {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');\n      if (token) {\n        config.headers = {\n          ...config.headers,\n          Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;,\n        };\n      }\n      return config;\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; response,\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 处理超时错误\n        if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {\n          const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n            code: 'TIMEOUT_ERROR',\n            message: '请求超时，请稍后重试。AI处理可能需要较长时间，请耐心等待。',\n            details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n          };\n          return Promise.reject(apiError);\n        }\n\n        const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n          code: error.response?.data?.error?.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message || '请求失败',\n          details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n        };\n\n        return Promise.reject(apiError);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  private unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response: AxiosResponse&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;): ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n    \n  }",

## 实现的功能

- 技术点列表：搜索、筛选、分页
- 技术点管理：创建、编辑、删除
- 技术点详情：完整信息展示、PDF/JSON 导出
- JSON 导入：支持从 JSON 导入技术点数据
- 字段对齐：技术原理、价值、边界、亮点、证据等
- 类型对齐：`tech_type`、`priority`、`status` 等字段

## 注意事项

1. 技术点库页面使用 Ant Design，与 TPD2 保持一致
2. HomePage 的导航按钮使用 Tailwind CSS，保持现有风格
3. 技术 IP 相关功能已预留接口，但当前暂未实现（标记为 disabled）
4. 同步服务已预留接口，后续可接入后端实现

所有代码已通过 linter 检查，无错误。功能已对齐 TPD2 项目的技术点模块。

        "contents": "export class TechCategoryModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类树结构\n   */\n  async getTree(): Promise&lt;TechCategory[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_categories \n      WHERE status = ? \n      ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, name ASC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ACTIVE]);\n    const categories = result as TechCategory[];\n    \n    // 构建树结构\n    const categoryMap = new Map&lt;number, TechCategory &amp; { children?: TechCategory[] }&gt;();\n    const rootCategories: (TechCategory &amp; { children?: TechCategory[] })[] = [];\n\n    // 初始化所有分类\n    categories.forEach(category =&gt; {\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\n    });\n\n    // 构建父子关系\n    categories.forEach(category =&gt; {\n      const categoryWithChildren = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\n      \n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\n        rootCategories.push(categoryWithChildren);\n      } else {\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id!);\n        if (parent) {\n          parent.children!.push(categoryWithChildren);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    return rootCategories;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术分类\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;TechCategory | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "async getTechPoints(\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (responseData.success &amp;&amp; responseData.data) {\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\n        \n        return {\n          success: true,\n          data: {\n            data: dataArray,\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\n            total,\n            page,\n            pageSize,\n            totalPages,\n          },\n          message: responseData.message,\n        };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error:\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\n          error.message ||\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();",

        "contents": "const TechPointLibraryPage: React.FC = \nconst [selectedTechPoint, setSelectedTechPoint] = &lt;TechPoint | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const loadTechCategories = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechCategories();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        // 确保 data 是数组\n        const categories = Array.isArray(response.data) \n          ? response.data \n          : [];\n        setTechCategories(categories);\n      } else {\n        setTechCategories([]);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载技术领域失败:', error);\n      setTechCategories([]);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadTechnologies = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 尝试加载技术IP列表（如果后端支持）\n      // 如果API不存在，这个功能会静默失败，不影响主要功能\n      // 后续可以在适配服务层时实现\n      setTechnologies([]);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载技术IP失败:', error);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadTechPoints = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const params: any = {\n        page: currentPage,\n        pageSize,\n      };\n      \n      if (searchKeyword) {\n        params.keyword = searchKeyword;\n      }\n      if (categoryFilter) {\n        params.category_id = categoryFilter;\n      }\n      if (typeFilter) {\n        params.tech_type = typeFilter;\n      }\n      if (priorityFilter) {\n        params.priority = priorityFilter;\n      }\n      if (statusFilter) {\n        params.status = statusFilter;\n      }\n\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints(params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        const data = Array.isArray(response.data.data) \n          ?         "contents": "export class TechCategoryModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有技术分类\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;TechCategory&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_categories';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data: result as TechCategory[],\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据父级ID获取子分类\n   */\n  async findByParentId(parentId: number | null, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;TechCategory[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

// 是否全量同步\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\n    errors: number;         "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * 技术点同步服务\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\n * \n * 后续实现功能：\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\n * 5. 同步日志记录\n */\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\n  /**\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n   * @param options 同步选项\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/tpd2', {\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\n      });\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\n   */\n,\n};",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {

        "contents": "import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\nimport {\n  TechPoint,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n} from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\n */\nclass TPDTechPointService {\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\n      timeout: 30000,\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; {\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\n        if (response.data &amp;&amp; response.data.code === 200) {\n          return {\n            ...response,\n            data: {\n              success: true,\n              data: response.data.data,\n              message: response.data.message,\n            },\n          };\n        }\n        return response;\n      },\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 错误响应格式转换\n        if (error.response &amp;&amp; error.response.data) {\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\n          return Promise.reject({\n            ...error,\n            response: {\n              ...error.response,\n              data: {\n                success: false,\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\n                code: tpdError.code,\n              },\n            },\n          });\n        }\n        return Promise.reject(error);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "class TPDTechPointService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\n   */\n  async getTechPoints(\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\n      const queryParams: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n\n      if (params?.page) {\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.keyword) {\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\n      }\n      if (params?.category_id) {\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.status) {\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\n      }\n      if (params?.type) {\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\n      }\n      if (params?.priority) {\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\n      }\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\n      }\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\n      }\n\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\n        params: queryParams,\n      });\n\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\n      const responseData = response.data;\n\n      if (responseData.success &amp;&amp; responseData.data)\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async getTechPoints(\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (responseData.success &amp;&amp; responseData.data) {\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\n        \n        return {\n          success: true,\n          data: {\n            data: dataArray,\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\n            total,\n            page,\n            pageSize,\n            totalPages,\n          },\n          message: responseData.message,\n        };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error:\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\n          error.message ||\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();",

        "contents": "export class TechPointController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   */\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      console.log('TechPointController.getAll called with query:', req.query);\n      \n      const {\n        page = 1,\n        pageSize = 20,\n        orderBy = 'created_at',\n        orderDirection = 'DESC',\n        status,\n        category_id,\n        parent_id,\n        tech_type,\n        priority\n      } = req.query;\n\n      const options = {\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n        where: {} as any\n      };\n\n      if (status) {\n        options.where.status = status;\n      }\n      if (category_id) {\n        options.where.category_id = parseInt(category_id as string);\n      }\n      if (parent_id !== undefined) {\n        options.where.parent_id = parent_id === 'null' ? null : parseInt(parent_id as string);\n      }\n      if (tech_type) {\n        options.where.tech_type = tech_type;\n      }\n      if (priority) {\n        options.where.priority = priority;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Query options:', options);\n      \n      const result = await techPointModel.findAll(options);\n      console.log('Query result:', result);\n      \n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: result\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Get tech points error:', error);\n      console.error('Error stack:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : 'Unknown error');\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取技术点列表失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据分类获取技术点\n   */\n  async getByCategoryId(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport {\n  KnowledgePoint,\n  CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  KnowledgePointQueryOptions,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/knowledgePoint';\n\nconst KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL = '/knowledge-points';\n\nexport const knowledgePointService = {\n  // 创建知识点\n  async create(data: CreateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post(KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options?: KnowledgePointQueryOptions\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const params = {\n      page: options?.page || 1,\n      pageSize: options?.pageSize || 10,\n      orderBy: options?.orderBy || 'created_at',\n      orderDirection: options?.orderDirection || 'DESC'\n    };\n    \n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/tech-point/${techPointId}&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点详情\n  async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

  "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * 技术点同步服务\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\n * \n * 后续实现功能：\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\n * 5. 同步日志记录\n */\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\n  /**\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n   * @param options 同步选项\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/tpd2', {\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\n      });\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\n   */\n  async syncToTPD2(techPointIds?: number[]): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number;\n    errors: number;\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/to-tpd2', {\n        techPointIds,\n      });\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步技术点到 TPD2 失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '同步技术点到 TPD2 失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 获取同步状态\n   */\n  async getSyncStatus(): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    lastSyncTime: string | null;\n    lastSyncType: 'from_tpd2' | 'to_tpd2' | null;\n    syncInProgress: boolean;\n    syncProgress?: {\n      total: number;\n      completed: number;\n      failed: number;\n    };\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/tech-points/sync/status');\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取同步状态失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '获取同步状态失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 获取同步日志\n   * @param options 查询选项\n   */\n  async getSyncLogs(options?: {\n    page?: number;\n    pageSize?: number;\n    startDate?: string;\n    endDate?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;{\n    id: number;\n    syncType: 'from_tpd2' | 'to_tpd2';\n    status: 'success' | 'failed' | 'partial';\n    syncedCount: number;\n    errorCount: number;\n    startTime: string;\n    endTime: string | null;\n    errorMessage?: string;\n  }&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get('/tech-points/sync/logs', {\n        params: options,\n      });\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取同步日志失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '获取同步日志失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n};\n\nexport default techPointSyncService;\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 127
}

err.message : '获取统计数据失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    fetchStatsData();\n  }, [selectedDays]);\n\n  // 下载统计数据\n  const handleDownload = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await workflowStatsService.downloadStats(selectedDays, 'json');\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('下载失败:', err);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 渲染加载状态\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-center\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-blue-600 mx-auto mb-4\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"text-gray-600\"&gt;加载统计数据中...&lt;/p&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  // 渲染错误状态\n  if (error)\n;",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * 技术点同步服务\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\n * \n * 后续实现功能：\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\n * 5. 同步日志记录\n */\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\n  /**\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n   * @param options 同步选项\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync/tpd2', {\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\n      });\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\n   */\n,\n};",

err.message : '获取统计数据失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 手动刷新数据\n  const handleRefresh = () =&gt; {\n    fetchStatsData();\n  };\n\n  // 切换自动刷新\n  const toggleAutoRefresh = () =&gt; {\n    setAutoRefresh(!autoRefresh);\n  };\n\n  // 准备图表数据\n  const prepareChartData = (data: WorkflowStatsOverview)\n;\n;",

typeof performanceMonitor.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(performanceMonitor.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('性能监控中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// Prometheus 指标中间件（放在性能监控之后）\nif (prometheusMetrics &amp;&amp; typeof prometheusMetrics.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(prometheusMetrics.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('Prometheus 指标中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// 添加请求日志中间件（放在最前面，但要在路由之前）\napp.use((req, res, next) =&gt; {\n  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\n  logger.info('收到请求', {\n    timestamp,\n    method: req.method,\n    url: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    ip: req.ip || req.connection.remoteAddress,\n    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),\n    body: req.body,\n    authorization: req.get('Authorization')?.substring(0, 20),\n    contentType: req.get('Content-Type'),\n  });\n  next();\n});\n\n// API 路由必须放在静态文件服务之前\n// 路由配置（API 保持 /api/v1 前缀）\napp.use('/api/v1', apiRoutes);\n\n// Dify API 代理路由\napp.use('/api/dify', difyProxyRoutes);\n\n// 公开访问接口（通过token获取配置和角色）\napp.get('/api/v1/public/:token', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { token } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAccessToken(token);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\n    }\n\n    // 获取角色列表\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }",

}

已完成“同步技术点”功能。功能总结：

## 已完成的功能

1. **创建了同步模态框组件** (`TechPointSyncModal.tsx`)
   - 支持选择同步方向（从 TPD2 同步到当前项目 / 从当前项目同步到 TPD2）
   - 显示同步进度
   - 显示同步结果（创建数、更新数、错误数等）
   - 错误处理和提示

2. **在 TechPointLibraryPage 中添加了“同步技术点”按钮**
   - 位于“新增技术点”按钮左侧
   - 使用 `SyncOutlined` 图标
   - 点击后打开同步模态框

3. **更新了同步服务** (`techPointSyncService.ts`)
   - 修正 API 路径，使用 `/tech-points/sync` 匹配后端路由
   - 处理后端返回的数据格式
   - 暂时禁用“同步到 TPD2”功能（后端尚未实现）

4. **功能特点**
   - 手动选择同步方向
   - 实时进度显示
   - 同步结果统计
   - 错误提示
   - 同步成功后自动刷新列表

## 注意事项

- “从当前项目同步到 TPD2”功能暂未实现（后端未提供对应 API），已在 UI 中禁用并标注
- 目前仅支持“从 TPD2 同步到当前项目”
- 同步过程中会显示进度条和统计信息
- 同步完成后会自动刷新技术点列表

功能已实现，可以测试同步功能。

        "contents": "export const ChatInput: React.FC&lt;ChatInputProps&gt; = ({\n  value,\n  isProcessing,\n  onChange,\n  onSend,\n  onKeyPress,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n    onChange(event.target.value);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"chat-input-area\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"input-container\"&gt;\n        &lt;input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={value}\n          onChange={handleChange}\n          onKeyPress={onKeyPress}\n          placeholder=\"输入您的问题或需求...\"\n          className=\"chat-input\"\n          disabled={isProcessing}\n        /&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"input-actions\"&gt;\n          &lt;button className=\"voice-btn\" disabled={isProcessing}&gt;\n            &lt;Mic size={20} /&gt;\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            className=\"send-btn\"\n            onClick={onSend}\n            disabled={!value.trim() || isProcessing}\n          &gt;\n            &lt;Send size={20} /&gt;\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};",

        "contents": "const AddTextModal: React.FC&lt;AddTextModalProps&gt; = \nconst handleSubmit = async \n {\n      if (files.length === 0) {\n        alert(\"请选择文件\");\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 上传文件到服务器\n      setIsUploading(true);\n      try {\n        const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(files, pageType);\n        \n        // 将每个上传的文件转换为Source并添加到来源列表\n        uploadedFiles.forEach((uploadedFile) =&gt; {\n          // description字段包含完整的markdown内容，用于传递给Agent\n          // 如果没有markdown内容，则使用文件大小作为描述\n          const description = uploadedFile.markdownContent \n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent\n            : &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&#96;;\n          \n          onAddTextSource({\n            title: uploadedFile.name,\n            type: \"external\",\n            url: uploadedFile.url,\n            description: description,\n          });\n        });\n        \n        setFiles([]);\n        onClose();\n        // 触发文件列表刷新\n        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filesUploaded'));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n        alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n      } finally {\n        setIsUploading(false);\n      }\n    } else if (mode === \"search\") {\n      if (!searchQuery.trim()) {\n        alert(\"请输入检索信息\");\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 创建检索信息来源，说明需要AI检索补充信息\n      onAddTextSource({\n        title: &#96;检索信息: ${searchQuery.trim().slice(0, 30)}${searchQuery.trim().length &gt; 30 ? \"...\" : \"\"}&#96;,\n        type: \"external\",\n        description: &#96;[检索信息] ${searchQuery.trim()}\\n\\n说明：此来源需要AI检索补充相关信息。&#96;,\n      });\n      \n      setSearchQuery(\"\");\n      onClose();\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt;\n;\n;",

已修复 Ant Design 的废弃属性警告。

## 修复内容

将 `Input.Search` 的 `enterButton` 替换为 `Space.Compact`，这是 Ant Design 5.x 推荐的做法。

**修复前：**
```tsx
<Search
  placeholder="搜索技术点名称、描述..."
  allowClear
  enterButton={<SearchOutlined />}
  onSearch={handleSearch}
  onChange={(e) => {
    if (!e.target.value) {
      handleSearch('');
    }
  }}
/>
```

**修复后：**
```tsx
<Space.Compact style={{ width: '100%' }}>
  <Input
    placeholder="搜索技术点名称、描述..."
    allowClear
    value={searchKeyword}
    onChange={(e) => {
      const value = e.target.value;
      setSearchKeyword(value);
      if (!value) {
        handleSearch('');
      }
    }}
    onPressEnter={(e) => {
      handleSearch((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
    }}
  />
  <Button
    type="primary"
    icon={<SearchOutlined />}
    onClick={() => handleSearch(searchKeyword)}
  >
    搜索
  </Button>
</Space.Compact>
```

## 改进点

1. 移除了废弃的 `addonAfter` 属性（`Input.Search` 内部使用）
2. 使用 `Space.Compact` 替代，符合 Ant Design 5.x 规范
3. 功能保持一致：支持回车搜索、清空按钮、点击按钮搜索
4. 移除了未使用的 `Search` 常量定义

现在不会再有关于 `addonAfter` 废弃的警告。请刷新页面测试。

        "contents": "const TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = \n\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 初始加载\n    loadActiveConfigs();\n\n    // 监听配置更新事件\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&gt; {\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\n        loadActiveConfigs();\n      }\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n    \n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&gt; {\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; config.address\n      );\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 初始加载\n    loadActiveConfigs();\n  }\n;",

   - 当前页面按钮会高亮显示（蓝色背景）

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource = async \n', saveResult.error);\n        return null;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 处理跳转到技术策略或技术包装页面\n  const handleNavigateToAIPage = async (pageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-package') =&gt; {\n    // 收集所有需要保存的来源 ID\n    const sourceIds: string[] = [];\n    \n    // 1. 总结并保存对话内容\n    const conversationSourceId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(pageType);\n    if (conversationSourceId) {\n      sourceIds.push(conversationSourceId);\n    }\n    \n    // 2. 保存技术转译内容\n    const translationSourceId = await saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource(pageType);\n    if (translationSourceId) {\n      sourceIds.push(translationSourceId);\n    }\n    \n    // 构建跳转 URL\n    let url = &#96;/${pageType}&#96;;\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\n    \n    if (projectId) {\n      params.append('projectId', projectId);\n      // 添加 newConversation 参数，确保创建新对话\n      params.append('newConversation', 'true');\n    }\n    \n    // 添加所有 sourceId（支持多个）\n    sourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&gt; {\n      params.append('sourceId', sourceId);\n    });\n    \n    if (params.toString()) {\n      url += &#96;?${params.toString()}&#96;;\n    }\n\n    // 跳转\n    navigate(url);\n  };\n\n  if (loading || checkingHistory) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!project) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-gray-500\"&gt;项目不存在&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 提炼为技术点\n  const handleExtractTechPoint = async (record: SourceInformation) =&gt; {\n    setExtractingTechPoint(true);\n    setExtractingSourceId(record.id);\n    \n    try {\n      // 获取对话内容\n      const conversationContent = record.description || record.title || '';\n      \n      // 构建AI提示词，要求提取技术点信息并转换为JSON格式\n      const extractPrompt = &#96;你是一个技术信息提取专家。请分析以下对话内容，提炼关键信息并转换为技术点的标准JSON格式。\n\n对话内容：\n${conversationContent}\n\n请提取以下关键信息并生成JSON：\n\n必需字段：\n1. name: 技术名称（简短、准确，不超过50字）\n2. description: 技术描述（1-2句话概括，不超过200字）\n3. tech_type: 技术类型（必须是：feature、improvement、innovation、technology 之一）\n4. priority: 优先级（必须是：low、medium、high 之一）\n5. technical_details: 技术细节（JSON对象，可以包含：tech_principle技术原理、tech_value技术价值、tech_boundary技术边界等）\n6. benefits: 技术优势（字符串数组，列出3-5个关键优势，每个不超过100字）\n7. applications: 应用场景（字符串数组，列出应用场景，每个不超过100字）\n8. keywords: 关键词（字符串数组，提取3-8个关键词）\n9. features: 特性说明（字符串，格式化的markdown，包含：\n   - 【一句话说明（slogan）】\n   - 【技术品牌定位与愿景】\n   - 【用户体验与场景】\n   如果信息不足，可以使用\"敬请期待\"作为占位符）\n\n输出要求：\n- 只返回JSON格式，不要包含任何markdown代码块标记或其他文字说明\n- JSON必须是有效的，可以直接用JSON.parse()解析\n- 如果某些信息无法从对话中提取，使用合理的默认值或空值\n- 所有数组字段必须是数组格式，即使为空也要使用[]\n- technical_details必须是对象格式，即使为空也要使用{}\n\n示例JSON格式：\n{\n  \"name\": \"技术名称\",\n  \"description\": \"技术描述\",\n  \"tech_type\": \"feature\",\n  \"priority\": \"medium\",\n  \"technical_details\": {\n    \"tech_principle\": \"技术原理说明\",\n    \"tech_value\": \"技术价值说明\",\n    \"tech_boundary\": \"技术边界说明\"\n  },\n  \"benefits\": [\"优势1\", \"优势2\", \"优势3\"],\n  \"applications\": [\"场景1\", \"场景2\"],\n  \"keywords\": [\"关键词1\", \"关键词2\", \"关键词3\"],\n  \"features\": \"【一句话说明（slogan）】\\\\n说明内容\\\\n【技术品牌定位与愿景】\\\\n定位：定位说明\\\\n愿景：愿景说明\\\\n【用户体验与场景】\\\\n场景说明\"\n}\n\n现在请分析对话内容并返回JSON：&#96;;\n;\n;",

setSyncModalVisible(true)}\n                &gt;\n                  同步技术点\n                &lt;/Button&gt;\n                &lt;Button\n                  type=\"primary\"\n                  icon={&lt;PlusOutlined /&gt;}\n                  onClick={handleCreate}\n                &gt;\n                  新增技术点\n                &lt;/Button&gt;\n              &lt;/Space&gt;\n            &lt;/Col&gt;\n          &lt;/Row&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n\n        {/* 搜索和筛选 */}\n        &lt;Card size=\"small\" style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}&gt;\n          &lt;Row gutter={16}&gt;\n            &lt;Col span={6}&gt;\n              &lt;Space.Compact style={{ width: '100%' }}&gt;\n                &lt;Input\n                  placeholder=\"搜索技术点名称、描述...\"\n                  allowClear\n                  value={searchKeyword}\n                  onChange={(e) =&gt; {\n                    const value = e.target.value;\n                    setSearchKeyword(value);\n                    if (!value) {\n                      handleSearch('');\n                    }\n                  }}\n                  onPressEnter={(e) =&gt; {\n                    handleSearch((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value);\n                  }}\n                /&gt;\n                &lt;Button\n                  type=\"primary\"\n                  icon={&lt;SearchOutlined /&gt;}\n                  onClick={() =&gt; handleSearch(searchKeyword)}\n                &gt;\n                  搜索\n                &lt;/Button&gt;\n              &lt;/Space.Compact&gt;\n            &lt;/Col&gt;\n            &lt;Col span={4}&gt;\n              &lt;Select\n                placeholder=\"技术领域\"\n                allowClear\n                style={{ width: '100%' }}\n                value={categoryFilter}\n                onChange={(value) =&gt; {\n                  setCategoryFilter(value);\n                  handleFilterChange();\n                }}\n              &gt;\n                {Array.isArray(techCategories) &amp;&amp; techCategories.map(category =&gt; (\n                  &lt;Select.Option key={category.id} value={category.id}&gt;\n                    {category.name}\n                  &lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n                ))}\n              &lt;/Select&gt;\n            &lt;/Col&gt;\n            &lt;Col span={4}&gt;\n              &lt;Select\n                placeholder=\"技术类型\"\n                allowClear\n                style={{ width: '100%' }}\n                value={typeFilter}\n                onChange={(value) =&gt; {\n                  setTypeFilter(value);\n                  handleFilterChange();\n                }}\n              &gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"feature\"&gt;功能特性&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"improvement\"&gt;改进优化&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"innovation\"&gt;创新技术&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"technology\"&gt;核心技术&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n              &lt;/Select&gt;\n            &lt;/Col&gt;\n            &lt;Col span={4}&gt;\n              &lt;Select\n                placeholder=\"优先级\"\n                allowClear\n                style={{ width: '100%' }}\n                value={priorityFilter}\n                onChange={(value) =&gt; {\n                  setStatusFilter(value);\n                  handleFilterChange();\n                }}\n              &gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"draft\"&gt;草稿&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"active\"&gt;启用&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"inactive\"&gt;禁用&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n                &lt;Select.Option value=\"archived\"&gt;归档&lt;/Select.Option&gt;\n              &lt;/Select&gt;\n            &lt;/Col&gt;\n            &lt;Col span={2}&gt;\n              &lt;Button\n                onClick={() =&gt; 已将关联技术点选择改为从技术点库页面选择。总结修改：

## 已完成的修改

### 1. **ProjectResourcesPage 修改**
   - 将点击"暂无已选择的技术点"时的行为从打开模态框改为跳转到技术点库页面
   - 添加了处理从技术点库返回选中技术点的逻辑
   - 使用 URL 参数传递返回地址和已选择的技术点ID

### 2. **TechPointLibraryPage 修改**
   - 添加选择模式支持（通过 URL 参数 `mode=select` 触发）
   - 在选择模式下：
     - 显示复选框列（使用 Table 的 `rowSelection`）
     - 支持多选技术点
     - 支持全选/取消全选
     - 点击行切换选中状态
     - 显示"取消"和"确认选择"按钮
     - 确认后将选中的技术点ID传回项目资源页面
   - 根据模式显示不同的UI和操作按钮

### 3. **功能流程**
   1. 在项目资源页面点击"暂无已选择的技术点"
   2. 跳转到技术点库页面（带选择模式参数）
   3. 在技术点库页面选择技术点（可多选）
   4. 点击"确认选择"按钮
   5. 返回项目资源页面，自动更新已选择的技术点列表

功能已实现。用户可以从技术点库页面选择技术点，选择完成后会自动返回项目资源页面并更新已选择的技术点。

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",
