        "contents": "CREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (",

          },

            "text": "    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建技术点\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_points (\n        name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n        priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n        keywords, source_url, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.category_id || null,\n      data.parent_id || null,\n      data.level || 1,\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 创建数据库",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "USE todify3;",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 1. 技术分类表",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE tech_categories (",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 2. 车型车系表",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE car_models (",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',",
            "lineNumber": 25

          {
            "text": "    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',",

{\n    if (this.pool) {\n      await this.pool.end();\n      console.log('PostgreSQL数据库连接已关闭');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 数据库管理器\nexport class DatabaseManager {\n  private sqliteManager: SQLiteManager | null = null;\n  private postgresManager: PostgreSQLManager | null = null;\n  private config: DatabaseConfig;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.config = getDatabaseConfig();\n    this.initializeManager();\n  }\n\n  private initializeManager(): void {\n    if (this.config.type === 'sqlite' &amp;&amp; this.config.sqlite) {\n      this.sqliteManager = new SQLiteManager(this.config.sqlite.path);\n    } else if (this.config.type === 'postgresql' &amp;&amp; this.config.postgresql) {\n      this.postgresManager = new PostgreSQLManager(this.config.postgresql);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async connect(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    if (this.config.type === 'sqlite' &amp;&amp; this.sqliteManager) {\n      await this.sqliteManager.connect();\n    } else if (this.config.type === 'postgresql' &amp;&amp; this.postgresManager) {\n      await this.postgresManager.connect();\n    }\n  }\n\n  async query(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    if (this.config.type === 'sqlite' &amp;&amp; this.sqliteManager) {\n      return await this.sqliteManager.query(sql, params);\n    } else if (this.config.type === 'postgresql' &amp;&amp; this.postgresManager) {\n      return await this.postgresManager.query(sql, params);\n    }\n    throw new Error('数据库管理器未初始化');\n  }\n\n  async close(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    if (this.config.type === 'sqlite' &amp;&amp; this.sqliteManager) {\n      await this.sqliteManager.close();\n    } else if (this.config.type === 'postgresql' &amp;&amp; this.postgresManager) {\n      await this.postgresManager.close();\n    }\n  }\n\n  getType(): DatabaseType {\n    return this.config.type;\n  }\n\n  // 事务支持（简化版本）\n  async transaction(): Promise&lt;{\n    query: (sql: string, params?: any[]) =&gt; Promise&lt;any&gt;;\n    commit: () =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n    rollback: () =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n  }&gt; {\n    // 简化的事务实现，实际项目中需要更完善的事务管理\n    return {\n      query: async (sql: string, params: any[] = []) =&gt; {\n        return await this.query(sql, params);\n      },\n      commit: async () =&gt; {\n        // 在实际实现中，这里应该提交事务\n        return Promise.resolve();\n      },\n      rollback: async () =&gt; {\n        // 在实际实现中，这里应该回滚事务\n        return Promise.resolve();\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例数据库管理器\nexport const db = new DatabaseManager();\n\n// 测试数据库连接\nexport async function testConnection(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  try {\n    await db.connect();\n    console.log('✅ SQLite数据库连接成功');\n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('数据库连接测试失败:', error);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n// 执行查询的便捷函数\nexport async function query(sql: string, params?: any[]): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n  return await db.query(sql, params || []);\n}",

  "contents": "import axios from 'axios';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 同步服务\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\n */\nexport class TPDSyncService {\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n          stats.errors++;\n          hasMore = false;\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        message: &#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&#96;,\n        stats,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\n        stats,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步单个技术点\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{created: boolean}&gt;} 返回是否为新创建\n   */\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\n        &#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&#96;,\n        {\n          params: {\n            includeAssociations: true,\n          },\n          timeout: 30000,\n        }\n      );\n\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\n      }\n\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\n\n      // 准备技术点数据\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\n      };\n\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称查找，因为 ID 可能不同）\n      // 首先尝试通过 ID 查找\n      let existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\n    };\n    return typeMap[tpdType] || TechType.FEATURE;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射优先级\n   */\n  private mapPriority(tpdPriority: string): Priority {\n    const priorityMap: Record&lt;string, Priority&gt; = {\n      low: Priority.LOW,\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\n    };\n    return priorityMap[tpdPriority] || Priority.MEDIUM;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射状态\n   */\n  private mapStatus(tpdStatus: string): Status {\n    const statusMap: Record&lt;string, Status&gt; = {\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\n    };\n    return statusMap[tpdStatus] || Status.DRAFT;\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdSyncService = new TPDSyncService();\n\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 241
}

        "contents": "constructor(dbPath: string) {\n\n  }\n\n  async connect(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      // 确保数据目录存在\n      const dir = path.dirname(this.dbPath);\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n      }\n\n      this.db = new sqlite3.Database(this.dbPath, (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          console.error('❌ SQLite连接失败:', err);\n          reject(err);\n        } else {\n          console.log('✅ SQLite数据库连接成功');\n          resolve();\n        }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async query(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    if (!this.db) {\n      throw new Error('数据库未连接');\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "init_postgresql() {\n    info \"使用 PostgreSQL 数据库\"\n    \n    # 检查必要的环境变量\n    if [ -z \"$PGHOST\" ] || [ -z \"$PGDATABASE\" ] || [ -z \"$PGUSER\" ]; then\n        error \"PostgreSQL 配置不完整，请设置 PGHOST, PGDATABASE, PGUSER 环境变量\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    # 执行架构脚本\n    info \"执行数据库架构脚本...\"\n    psql -h \"$PGHOST\" -d \"$PGDATABASE\" -U \"$PGUSER\" -f \"$SCHEMA_FILE\"\n    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then\n        info \"数据库架构创建成功\"\n    else\n        error \"数据库架构创建失败\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    # 执行索引脚本\n    info \"执行数据库索引脚本...\"\n    psql -h \"$PGHOST\" -d \"$PGDATABASE\" -U \"$PGUSER\" -f \"$INDEXES_FILE\"\n    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then\n        info \"数据库索引创建成功\"\n    else\n        error \"数据库索引创建失败\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    info \"PostgreSQL 数据库初始化完成\"\n}\n\n# 主函数\nmain() {\n    info \"开始初始化 Todify3 数据库 v2.0\"\n    info \"==================================\"\n    \n    check_files\n    \n    case \"$DB_TYPE\" in\n        sqlite)\n            init_sqlite\n            ;;\n        postgresql|postgres)\n            init_postgresql\n            ;;\n        *)\n            error \"不支持的数据库类型: $DB_TYPE\"\n            error \"支持的数据库类型: sqlite, postgresql\"\n            exit 1\n            ;;\n    esac\n    \n    info \"==================================\"\n    info \"数据库初始化完成！\"\n}\n\n# 执行主函数\nmain",

        "contents": "## 数据库表完整列表（20个）\n\n数据库文件: ./data/todify2.db\n\n### 核心配置表 (6个):\nagent_workflows - Agent工作流 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nai_roles - AI角色配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_templates - 工作流模板 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npublic_page_configs - 公开页面配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npage_tool_configs - 页面工具配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n\n### AI搜索相关表 (4个):\nai_search_conversations - AI搜索对话 [服务✅]\nai_search_messages - AI搜索消息 [服务✅]\nai_search_outputs - AI搜索输出 [服务✅]\nai_search_field_mappings - AI搜索字段映射 [服务✅]\n\n### 聊天对话表 (4个):\nconversations - 对话会话 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nchat_messages - 聊天消息 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nknowledge_usage_logs - 知识使用日志 [服务✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [服务✅ 路由✅] (与第3项重复)\n\n\n### 业务数据表 (5个):\nbrands - 品牌 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_models - 车型 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_series - 车系 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_categories - 技术分类 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_points - 技术点 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 文件和服务表 (2个):\nfiles - 文件存储 [服务✅]\nworkflow_stats_summary - 工作流统计 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 来源信息表 (1个):\nsource_information - 来源信息 [模型✅ 路由✅]",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 文件唯一标识\n    original_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 原始文件名\n    stored_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 存储的文件名\n    file_path TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件存储路径\n    file_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件访问URL\n    mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件MIME类型\n    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 文件大小（字节）\n    file_hash TEXT, -- 文件哈希值（用于去重）\n    category TEXT DEFAULT 'general', -- 文件分类\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储标签\n    description TEXT, -- 文件描述\n    uploader_id TEXT, -- 上传者ID\n    conversation_id TEXT, -- 关联的对话ID（可选）\n    usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 使用次数\n    last_used_at DATETIME, -- 最后使用时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 工作流节点使用统计表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_node_usage (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    node_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点ID",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nmodule.exports = {\n  apps: [\n    {\n      name: 'todify3-backend',\n      script: './backend/dist/index.js',\n      cwd: '/root/todify3',\n      env: {\n        NODE_ENV: 'production',\n        PORT: 2203,\n        SQLITE_DB_PATH: '/root/todify3/backend/data/todify3.db',\n        DB_TYPE: 'sqlite'\n      },\n      autorestart: true,  // 自动重启\n      // ...\n    }\n  ]\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### systemd服务文件\n\n位置: &#96;/etc/systemd/system/pm2-root.service&#96;\n\n关键配置:\n- &#96;ExecStart&#96;: 启动时执行 &#96;pm2 resurrect&#96; 恢复进程\n- &#96;Restart=on-failure&#96;: 失败时自动重启\n- &#96;After=network.target&#96;: 在网络启动后启动\n\n## 最佳实践\n\n1. **定期保存PM2配置**: 每次修改服务后运行 &#96;pm2 save&#96;\n2. **监控服务状态**: 定期检查 &#96;pm2 list&#96; 和 &#96;systemctl status pm2-root.service&#96;\n3. **日志管理**: 定期清理日志文件，避免磁盘空间不足\n4. **测试重启**: 在非生产环境测试自动启动功能\n\n## 相关文件\n\n- &#96;ecosystem.config.js&#96;: PM2配置文件\n- &#96;setup-autostart.sh&#96;: 自动启动配置脚本\n- &#96;scripts/start-services.sh&#96;: 服务管理脚本\n- &#96;/etc/systemd/system/pm2-root.service&#96;: systemd服务文件\n- &#96;/root/.pm2/dump.pm2&#96;: PM2保存的进程列表\n\n## 参考资源\n\n- [PM2官方文档](https://pm2.keymetrics.io/docs/usage/startup/)\n- [systemd服务管理](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/systemd.service.html)",

        "contents": "-- 文件存储表\n-- 用于存储上传的文件信息，支持后续反复调用\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 文件唯一标识\n  original_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 原始文件名\n  stored_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 存储的文件名\n  file_path TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件存储路径\n  file_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件访问URL\n  mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件MIME类型\n  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 文件大小（字节）\n  file_hash TEXT, -- 文件哈希值（用于去重）\n  category TEXT DEFAULT 'general', -- 文件分类（general, document, image等）\n  tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储标签\n  description TEXT, -- 文件描述\n  uploader_id TEXT, -- 上传者ID\n  conversation_id TEXT, -- 关联的对话ID（可选）\n  usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 使用次数\n  last_used_at DATETIME, -- 最后使用时间\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n  metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);",

        "contents": "import fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { db } from '../config/database';\n\nasync function setupProjectTables() {\n  try {\n    console.log('开始创建项目相关表...');\n    \n    // 读取SQL文件\n    const sqlPath = path.join(__dirname, 'create-project-tables.sql');\n    const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf-8');\n    \n    // 连接数据库\n    await db.connect();\n    \n    // 执行SQL（按语句分割执行，因为SQLite不支持多语句执行）\n    // 先移除所有注释行，然后按分号分割\n    const cleanedSql = sql\n      .split('\\n')\n      .filter(line =&gt; {\n        const trimmed = line.trim();\n        return trimmed.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !trimmed.startsWith('--');\n      })\n      .join('\\n');\n    \n    // 按分号分割，但保留多行语句\n    const statements = cleanedSql\n      .split(';')\n      .map(s =&gt; s.trim())\n      .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0);\n    \n    for (const statement of statements)\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "# 智能工作流统计系统部署指南\n\n## 🚀 快速部署\n\n### 1. 环境准备\n\n确保已安装以下环境：\n- Node.js 16+\n- npm 或 yarn\n- SQLite3\n\n### 2. 数据库初始化\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 进入后端目录\ncd backend\n\n# 安装依赖\nnpm install\n\n# 初始化统计数据库表\nnpx ts-node src/scripts/init-workflow-stats.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 启动服务\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 启动后端服务（终端1）\ncd backend\nnpm run dev\n\n# 启动前端服务（终端2）\ncd frontend\nnpm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. 访问系统\n\n- **统计页面**: http://localhost:3000/workflow-stats\n- **API接口**: http://localhost:3001/api/workflow-stats\n- **健康检查**: http://localhost:3001/api/health\n\n## 📊 功能验证\n\n### 1. 检查数据库表\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 进入后端目录\ncd backend\n\n# 检查表是否创建成功\nnpx ts-node -e \"\nimport { DatabaseManager } from './src/config/database';\nconst db = new DatabaseManager();\ndb.query('SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\\\"table\\\" AND name LIKE \\\"%workflow%\\\"')\n  .then(result =&gt; console.log('统计表:', result))\n  .catch(err =&gt; console.error(err));\n\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 测试API接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 测试统计概览接口\ncurl http://localhost:3001/api/workflow-stats/overview\n\n# 测试健康检查接口\ncurl http://localhost:3001/api/health\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 验证前端页面\n\n访问 http://localhost:3000/workflow-stats 查看统计页面是否正常显示。\n\n## 🔧 配置说明\n\n### 环境变量配置\n\n在 &#96;backend/.env&#96; 文件中配置：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# 数据库配置\nDB_TYPE=sqlite\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/unified.db\n\n# API配置\nPORT=3001\nNODE_ENV=development\n\n# 统计配置\nSTATS_ENABLED=true\nSTATS_RETENTION_DAYS=90\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 前端配置\n\n在 &#96;frontend/.env&#96; 文件中配置：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api\nREACT_APP_STATS_ENABLED=true\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📈 集成现有节点\n\n### 1. 在节点组件中添加统计收集\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { statsCollector } from '../utils/statsCollector';\n\nconst MyNodeComponent = () =&gt; {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    ",

        "contents": "/**\n * 初始化页面工具配置表和数据\n */\nimport { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport * as fs from 'fs';\nimport * as path from 'path';\n\nconst db = new DatabaseManager();\n\nasync function initPageToolConfigs() {\n  try {\n    await db.connect();\n    console.log('✅ 数据库连接成功');\n\n    // 读取SQL文件\n    const sqlFile = path.join(__dirname, 'create-page-tool-config-tables.sql');\n    const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlFile, 'utf-8');\n\n    // 执行SQL语句\n    const statements = sql\n      .split(';')\n      .map(s =&gt; s.trim())\n      .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith('--'));\n\n    for (const statement of statements) {\n      if (statement.trim()) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(statement);\n          console.log('✅ 执行SQL语句成功');\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表已存在的错误\n          if (error.message &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('already exists')) {\n            console.log('ℹ️  表已存在，跳过创建');\n          } else {\n            console.error('❌ 执行SQL语句失败:', error.message);\n            console.error('SQL:', statement.substring(0, 100) + '...');\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    console.log('✅ 页面工具配置表初始化完成');\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ 初始化失败:', error);\n    throw error;\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n  }\n}\n\n// 如果直接运行此脚本\nif (require.main === module)",

        "contents": "        # 更新 .env 文件中的端口和数据库配置\n        if [ -f \"${BACKEND_PATH}/.env\" ]; then\n            # 更新端口\n            sed -i \"s/^PORT=.*/PORT=${BACKEND_PORT}/\" ${BACKEND_PATH}/.env\n            # 更新环境为生产环境\n            sed -i \"s/^NODE_ENV=.*/NODE_ENV=production/\" ${BACKEND_PATH}/.env\n            # 确保数据库路径正确\n            if ! grep -q \"SQLITE_DB_PATH\" ${BACKEND_PATH}/.env; then\n                echo \"SQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify3.db\" &gt;&gt; ${BACKEND_PATH}/.env\n            else\n                sed -i \"s|^SQLITE_DB_PATH=.*|SQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify3.db|\" ${BACKEND_PATH}/.env\n            fi\n        else\n            # 创建默认 .env 文件\n            cat &gt; ${BACKEND_PATH}/.env &lt;&lt; EOFENV\nPORT=${BACKEND_PORT}\nNODE_ENV=production\nDB_TYPE=sqlite\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify3.db\nEOFENV\n        fi\n        \n        # 清理\n        rm -f /tmp/deploy.tar.gz\n        \n        echo \"✅ 文件解压完成\"\nENDSSH\n    \n    log_success \"项目文件上传完成\"\n}\n\n# 同步数据库和配置文件\nsync_database_and_config() {\n    log_info \"同步数据库和配置文件...\"\n    \n    # 备份云端数据库\n    sshpass -p \"$SERVER_PASSWORD\" ssh $SSH_OPTIONS $SERVER_USER@$SERVER_IP &lt;&lt; ENDSSH\n        cd ${BACKEND_PATH}\n        \n        # 创建备份目录\n        mkdir -p data/backup\n        \n        # 备份现有数据库\n        for db_file in data/*.db; do\n            if [ -f \"\\$db_file\" ]; then\n                backup_file=\"data/backup/\\$(basename \\$db_file).backup.\\$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)\"\n                cp \"\\$db_file\" \"\\$backup_file\"\n                echo \"✅ 已备份: \\$backup_file\"\n            fi\n        done\nENDSSH\n    \n    # 同步本地数据库文件",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/database/database-design-v2.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 300
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 377
          }
        },
        "contents": "复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：\n- &#96;dify_config&#96; - Dify配置\n- &#96;nodes&#96;、&#96;edges&#96; - 工作流结构\n- &#96;metadata&#96; - 元数据\n- &#96;tags&#96;、&#96;keywords&#96; - 数组数据\n\n## 四、索引设计\n\n### 4.1 索引策略\n\n1. **主键索引**：自动创建\n2. **外键索引**：为所有外键字段创建索引\n3. **查询索引**：为常用查询字段创建索引\n4. **复合索引**：为多字段组合查询创建复合索引\n\n### 4.2 重要索引\n\n- &#96;idx_workflow_executions_type&#96; - 按执行类型查询\n- &#96;idx_workflow_executions_type_status&#96; - 按类型和状态查询\n- &#96;idx_tech_points_category_status&#96; - 按分类和状态查询\n- &#96;idx_chat_messages_conv_status&#96; - 按对话和状态查询\n\n## 五、数据迁移\n\n### 5.1 迁移机制\n\n使用&#96;database_migrations&#96;表记录所有迁移历史：\n- migration_name: 迁移文件名\n- version: 版本号\n- executed_at: 执行时间\n- execution_time_ms: 执行耗时\n- status: 执行状态\n- error_message: 错误信息\n\n### 5.2 迁移工具\n\n使用&#96;migrate.ts&#96;工具执行迁移：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 六、使用说明\n\n### 6.1 初始化数据库\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# SQLite\nDB_TYPE=sqlite DB_PATH=./database.db ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\n\n# PostgreSQL\nDB_TYPE=postgresql PGHOST=localhost PGDATABASE=todify2 PGUSER=postgres ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 6.2 执行迁移\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 6.3 查看迁移状态\n\n迁移工具会自动记录执行状态到&#96;database_migrations&#96;表。\n\n## 七、注意事项\n\n1. **向后兼容**：新架构保持与现有代码的兼容性\n2. **数据备份**：执行迁移前必须备份现有数据\n3. **测试验证**：在测试环境充分验证新架构\n4. **性能测试**：验证索引优化后的查询性能\n5. **文档更新**：同步更新API文档和开发文档\n\n## 八、版本历史\n\n- **v2.0** (2025-01-XX): 统一数据库架构，解决表冲突，规范化命名\n- **v1.0**: 初始分散的数据库架构",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;dify_config&#96; - Dify配置",

          },
          {
            "text": "## 四、索引设计",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.1 索引策略",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **主键索引**：自动创建",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **外键索引**：为所有外键字段创建索引",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **查询索引**：为常用查询字段创建索引",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **复合索引**：为多字段组合查询创建复合索引",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.2 重要索引",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;idx_workflow_executions_type&#96; - 按执行类型查询",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;idx_workflow_executions_type_status&#96; - 按类型和状态查询",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;idx_tech_points_category_status&#96; - 按分类和状态查询",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;idx_chat_messages_conv_status&#96; - 按对话和状态查询",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "## 五、数据迁移",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.1 迁移机制",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "使用&#96;database_migrations&#96;表记录所有迁移历史：",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "- migration_name: 迁移文件名",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "- version: 版本号",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "- executed_at: 执行时间",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "- execution_time_ms: 执行耗时",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "- status: 执行状态",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "- error_message: 错误信息",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.2 迁移工具",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "使用&#96;migrate.ts&#96;工具执行迁移：",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "ts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "## 六、使用说明",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.1 初始化数据库",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "# SQLite",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "DB_TYPE=sqlite DB_PATH=./database.db ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "# PostgreSQL",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "DB_TYPE=postgresql PGHOST=localhost PGDATABASE=todify2 PGUSER=postgres ./backend/src/scripts/init-database-v2.sh",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.2 执行迁移",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "text": "ts-node backend/src/scripts/migrate.ts",
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.3 查看迁移状态",
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "迁移工具会自动记录执行状态到&#96;database_migrations&#96;表。",
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "text": "## 七、注意事项",
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **向后兼容**：新架构保持与现有代码的兼容性",
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **数据备份**：执行迁移前必须备份现有数据",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **测试验证**：在测试环境充分验证新架构",
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **性能测试**：验证索引优化后的查询性能",
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **文档更新**：同步更新API文档和开发文档",
            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "text": "## 八、版本历史",
            "lineNumber": 373
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "- **v2.0** (2025-01-XX): 统一数据库架构，解决表冲突，规范化命名",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "text": "- **v1.0**: 初始分散的数据库架构",
            "lineNumber": 376
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2949427366256714

        "contents": "| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| avatar | TEXT | 头像URL |\n| system_prompt | TEXT | 系统提示词 |\n| dify_config | TEXT | JSON字符串，Dify配置 |\n| enabled | INTEGER | 是否启用（0/1） |\n| source | TEXT | 来源标记 |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\n\n**dify_config JSON结构**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"apiUrl\": \"string\",\n  \"apiKey\": \"string\",\n  \"connectionType\": \"chatflow\" | \"workflow\",\n  \"inputFields\": [...]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2.5.2 公开页面配置表 (public_page_configs)\n\n存储公开页面配置。\n\n#### 2.5.3 页面工具配置表 (page_tool_configs)\n\n存储页面工具配置，按页面类型唯一。\n\n#### 2.5.4 文件表 (files)\n\n存储上传的文件信息。\n\n#### 2.5.5 统计表\n\n- **workflow_node_usage** - 工作流节点使用统计\n- **ai_qa_feedback** - AI问答评价统计\n- **workflow_session_stats** - 工作流会话统计\n- **node_content_processing** - 节点内容处理统计\n- **workflow_stats_summary** - 实时统计汇总\n\n## 三、关键设计决策\n\n### 3.1 workflow_executions表统一\n\n**问题**：原有两个不同的&#96;workflow_executions&#96;表定义：\n1. Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）\n2. Dify工作流执行表（INTEGER主键，包含workflow_run_id、task_id等）\n\n**解决方案**：\n- 合并为统一表，使用TEXT主键\n- 添加&#96;execution_type&#96;字段区分类型\n- 包含两种类型的所有字段，根据类型使用相应字段\n\n### 3.2 主键类型规范\n\n- **核心业务表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT（brands, car_models, tech_points等）\n- **配置表**：使用TEXT（UUID或自定义ID）（ai_roles, agent_workflows等）\n- **关联表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT\n\n### 3.3 命名规范\n\n- **表名**：使用复数形式（tech_points而非tech_point）\n- **字段名**：统一使用snake_case\n- **索引名**：统一格式&#96;idx_表名_字段名&#96;\n\n### 3.4 JSON字段存储\n\n复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：\n- &#96;dify_config&#96; - Dify配置",

        },
        "contents": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\n\n## 一、概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\n\n### 1.1 设计目标\n\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\n\n### 1.2 架构分层\n\n数据库架构分为五层：\n\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\n\n## 二、表结构设计\n\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\n\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\n\n存储汽车品牌信息。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\n\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },

            "text": "- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护",

            "text": "数据库架构分为五层：",

            "text": "1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据",

          },
          {
            "text": "2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系",

          {
            "text": "3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）",

          {
            "text": "4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息",

          {
            "text": "## 二、表结构设计",

          {
            "text": "### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层",

          {

          {
            "text": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |",
            "lineNumber": 35

          {
            "text": "| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |",

        },
        "contents": "# 技术文档\n\n## 1. 系统架构\n\n基于 &#96;system-architecture.md&#96; 和 &#96;后端项目架构规划.md&#96; 的规划，Todify3 采用前后端分离的现代 Web 应用架构。\n\n### 1.1 总体架构图\n\n系统技术架构图如下所示，展示了前端、后端、数据库和 Dify API 之间的交互关系。\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\ngraph TD\n    A[用户浏览器] --&gt; B{前端 (React + Vite)};\n    B --&gt; C{后端 (Node.js + Express.js)};\n    C --&gt; D[数据库 (Prisma + SQLite/PostgreSQL)];\n    C --&gt; E[Dify API];\n    E --&gt; C;\n    D --&gt; C;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 1.2 技术栈\n\n*   **前端**: React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS Modules\n*   **后端**: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript\n*   **数据库**: SQLite (开发), PostgreSQL (生产)\n*   **ORM**: Prisma\n*   **核心 AI 服务**: Dify API\n*   **部署**: Docker, Nginx\n\n## 2. 后端设计\n\n后端遵循 &#96;后端项目架构规划.md&#96; 中定义的分层架构，以实现高内聚、低耦合的设计目标。\n\n### 2.1 核心数据模型 (Prisma Schema)\n\n核心数据模型围绕 &#96;WorkflowDefinition&#96;, &#96;FieldMapping&#96;, 和 &#96;Task&#96; 构建。\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;prisma\n// schema.prisma\n\ndatasource db {\n  provider = \"postgresql\"\n  url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n}\n\ngenerator client {\n  provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n}\n\n// 用户模型\nmodel User {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  email     String   @unique\n  password  String\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n  tasks     Task[]\n}\n\n// 工作流任务模型\nmodel Task {\n  id          String    @id @default(cuid())\n  userId      String\n  user        User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])\n  workflowId  String    // 关联到 Dify 的工作流 ID\n  status      String    // e.g., 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed'\n  inputData   Json      // 用户输入的数据\n  outputData  Json?     // Dify 返回的生成结果\n  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt\n}\n\n// 字段映射配置 (存储为 JSON 文件或数据库记录)\n// 此部分将通过配置文件管理，以实现动态映射\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

## 导入结果汇总

### 导入的数据
- **技术分类**: 6 个
  - 大安全 (ID: 1)
  - 智能化 (ID: 2)
  - 新能源 (ID: 3)
  - 数字底盘与架构 (ID: 4)
  - 大健康 (ID: 5)
  - 全球化 (ID: 6)

- **技术点**: 33 个
  - 包括：千里浩瀚H7、千里浩瀚H5、雷神AI电混2.0、雷神EM-P超级电混、神盾电池安全系统等
  - 已保留原有 ID、分类关联、状态等字段

### 导入脚本位置
脚本位于 `backend/src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts`

### 后续使用
如需重新导入或更新数据，可运行：
```bash
cd backend
npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts
```

如需指定不同的 TPD2 数据库路径，可设置环境变量：
```bash
TPD2_DB_PATH=/path/to/tpd2/database.db npx ts-node ...
```

所有数据已成功导入到当前项目的技术点库中，可在技术点库页面查看和管理这些技术点。

{\n  const { id } = useParams&lt;{ id: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [techPoint, setTechPoint] = useState&lt;TechPoint | null&gt;(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (id) {\n      loadTechPointDetail();\n    }\n  }, [id]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const handleVisibilityChange = () =&gt; {\n      if (!document.hidden &amp;&amp; id) {\n        loadTechPointDetail();\n      }\n    };\n    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);\n    return () =&gt;         "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\n   */\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n    // 获取技术包装材料\n    const packagingSql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? \n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取推广策略\n    const promotionSql = &#96;\n      SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\n      JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取通稿\n    const pressSql = &#96;\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取演讲稿\n    const speechSql = &#96;\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \n      FROM tech_speeches sp\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n\n    const [packagingResult, promotionResult, pressResult, speechResult] = await Promise.all([\n      this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId])\n    ]);\n\n    return {\n      packagingMaterials: packagingResult,\n      promotionStrategies: promotionResult,\n      pressReleases: pressResult,\n      speeches: speechResult\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT cm.*, tcm.application_status, tcm.implementation_date, tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY cm.brand, cm.series, cm.model\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',",

    {
      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId,\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\n      implementationDate || null,\n      notes || null\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result[0];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &gt; 0 : true;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新车型关联信息\n   */\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\n    techPointId: number,\n    carModelId: number,\n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \n      SET \n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      applicationStatus,\n      implementationDate,\n      notes,\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? result[0] : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 解析JSON字段\n   */\n  private parseJsonFields(row: any): any {\n    if (!row) return row;\n    \n    const jsonFields = ['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'];\n    const parsed = { ...row };\n    \n    jsonFields.forEach(field =&gt; {\n      if (parsed[field] &amp;&amp; typeof parsed[field] === 'string') {\n        try {\n          parsed[field] = JSON.parse(parsed[field]);\n        } catch (e) {\n          // 如果解析失败，保持原值\n        }\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return parsed;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 3. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  NOW(),\n  NOW()\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != ''\nON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW();\n\n-- 4. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nRENAME TABLE car_models TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 5. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本 (SQLite版本)\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  logo_url TEXT,\n  country TEXT,\n  founded_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 创建更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS brands_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON brands\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE brands SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 3. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 4. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT OR IGNORE INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  datetime('now'),\n  datetime('now')\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != '';\n\n-- 5. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nALTER TABLE car_models RENAME TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 7. 创建车型表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_models_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_models\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_models SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本 (SQLite版本)",

          },

            "lineNumber": 2

          {
            "text": "-- 1. 创建品牌表",
            "lineNumber": 3

          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (",
            "lineNumber": 4

          },
          {

        "contents": "# 三层级车系架构设计\n\n## 概述\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\n\n## 层级关系\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n品牌 (Brand)\n├── 车型 (Model) \n    ├── 车系 (Series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据库设计\n\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\n\n## 一、概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\n\n### 1.1 设计目标\n\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\n\n### 1.2 架构分层\n\n数据库架构分为五层：\n\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\n\n## 二、表结构设计\n\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\n\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\n\n存储汽车品牌信息。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\n\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_status ON car_models(status);\n\n-- 9. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  generation TEXT,\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  market_segment TEXT CHECK (market_segment IN ('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium')),\n  body_style TEXT,\n  engine_types TEXT, -- JSON格式存储\n  fuel_types TEXT,   -- JSON格式存储\n  description TEXT,\n  metadata TEXT,     -- JSON格式存储\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 创建车系表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_series_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_series\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_series SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 11. 创建车系表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_model_id ON car_series(model_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_status ON car_series(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_series_market_segment ON car_series(market_segment);\n\n-- 12. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车型记录\n-- 这里假设原有的 series 字段实际上是车型名称\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  b.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型'),\n  '从原有数据迁移',\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nWHERE cst.series IS NOT NULL AND cst.series != '';\n\n-- 13. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车系记录",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  generation VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '世代信息',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  market_segment ENUM('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium') COMMENT '市场定位',\n  body_style VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '车身样式',\n  engine_types JSON COMMENT '发动机类型',\n  fuel_types JSON COMMENT '燃料类型',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车系描述',\n  metadata JSON COMMENT '额外信息',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_model_id (model_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status),\n  INDEX idx_market_segment (market_segment)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据示例\n\n### 品牌数据\n- 奥迪 (Audi)\n- 宝马 (BMW)\n- 奔驰 (Mercedes-Benz)\n\n### 车型数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列\n- 奥迪 Q 系列\n- 宝马 1 系列\n- 宝马 3 系列\n- 宝马 X 系列\n\n### 车系数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列 -&gt; A3, A4, A6, A8\n- 奥迪 Q 系列 -&gt; Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8\n- 宝马 3 系列 -&gt; 3系轿车, 3系旅行车, 3系GT\n\n## API 接口设计\n\n### 品牌相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/brands - 获取品牌列表\n- POST /api/v1/brands - 创建品牌\n- PUT /api/v1/brands/:id - 更新品牌\n- DELETE /api/v1/brands/:id - 删除品牌\n\n### 车型相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/models - 获取车型列表\n- GET /api/v1/brands/:brandId/models - 获取指定品牌的车型\n- POST /api/v1/models - 创建车型\n- PUT /api/v1/models/:id - 更新车型\n- DELETE /api/v1/models/:id - 删除车型\n\n### 车系相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/series - 获取车系列表\n- GET /api/v1/models/:modelId/series - 获取指定车型的车系\n- POST /api/v1/series - 创建车系\n- PUT /api/v1/series/:id - 更新车系",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE car_series (",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  model_id INT NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',",
            "lineNumber": 56

        "contents": "-- 6. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  generation VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '世代信息',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  market_segment ENUM('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium') COMMENT '市场定位',\n  body_style VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '车身样式',\n  engine_types JSON COMMENT '发动机类型',\n  fuel_types JSON COMMENT '燃料类型',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车系描述',\n  metadata JSON COMMENT '额外信息',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_model_id (model_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status),\n  INDEX idx_market_segment (market_segment)\n);\n\n-- 7. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车型记录\n-- 这里假设原有的 series 字段实际上是车型名称\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  b.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.series, '未知车型'),\n  '从原有数据迁移',\n  CASE \n    WHEN cst.status = 'active' THEN 'active'\n    WHEN cst.status = 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'\n    ELSE 'active'\n  END,\n  cst.created_at,\n  cst.updated_at\nFROM car_series_temp cst\nJOIN brands b ON b.name = cst.brand\nWHERE cst.series IS NOT NULL AND cst.series != '';\n\n-- 8. 数据迁移：从原有数据创建车系记录\nINSERT INTO car_series (\n  model_id, \n  name, \n  launch_year, \n  end_year, \n  market_segment,\n  description, \n  metadata, \n  status, \n  created_at, \n  updated_at\n)\nSELECT \n  cm.id,\n  COALESCE(cst.model, CONCAT(cst.series, ' 基础版')),",

        "contents": "-- 聊天消息相关数据库表结构\n-- 用于存储AI对话和Dify返回消息\n\n-- 1. 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库索引优化 v2.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 整合所有索引定义，优化查询性能\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层索引\n--
