        "contents": ");\n\n-- 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 知识使用日志表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_usage_logs (\n    ",

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/scripts/create-project-tables.sql",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        "contents": "-- 项目表\n-- 用于存储项目信息\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 项目来源表\n-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_title TEXT,\n    source_description TEXT,\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_last_opened_at ON projects(last_opened_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_project_id ON project_sources(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_source_type ON project_sources(source_type);",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- 项目表",

          },

            "text": "-- 用于存储项目信息",

          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (",

            "text": "    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 4

          {
            "text": "    name TEXT NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "    description TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "    cover_image TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "    icon TEXT,",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },

            "lineNumber": 11

          {

            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 项目来源表",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 20

          {
            "text": "    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),",

            "lineNumber": 28

            "lineNumber": 30

          {
            "text": "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);",

        "contents": "## 数据库表完整列表（20个）\n\n数据库文件: ./data/todify2.db\n\n### 核心配置表 (6个):\nagent_workflows - Agent工作流 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nai_roles - AI角色配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_templates - 工作流模板 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npublic_page_configs - 公开页面配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npage_tool_configs - 页面工具配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n\n### AI搜索相关表 (4个):\nai_search_conversations - AI搜索对话 [服务✅]\nai_search_messages - AI搜索消息 [服务✅]\nai_search_outputs - AI搜索输出 [服务✅]\nai_search_field_mappings - AI搜索字段映射 [服务✅]\n\n### 聊天对话表 (4个):\nconversations - 对话会话 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nchat_messages - 聊天消息 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nknowledge_usage_logs - 知识使用日志 [服务✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [服务✅ 路由✅] (与第3项重复)\n\n\n### 业务数据表 (5个):\nbrands - 品牌 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_models - 车型 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_series - 车系 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_categories - 技术分类 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_points - 技术点 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 文件和服务表 (2个):\nfiles - 文件存储 [服务✅]\nworkflow_stats_summary - 工作流统计 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 来源信息表 (1个):\nsource_information - 来源信息 [模型✅ 路由✅]",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    parent_id INTEGER,\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    category_id INTEGER,\n    parent_id INTEGER,\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    file_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES files(file_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与来源信息关联表（多对多，支持来源信息复用）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (source_information_id) REFERENCES source_information(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 在生成内容表中添加 project_id 字段\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 技术包装材料表添加 project_id\n-- 注意：如果表已存在，需要先检查字段是否存在\n-- SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS，需要手动检查\n-- 这里使用 ALTER TABLE，如果字段已存在会报错，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 为 tech_packaging_materials 添加 project_id\n-- 先检查表是否存在 project_id 列（通过尝试添加，如果失败则忽略）\n-- 实际执行时，如果字段已存在，需要手动处理或使用应用层检查\n\nALTER TABLE tech_packaging_materials ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_packaging_materials_project_id ON tech_packaging_materials(project_id);\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL",

        "contents": ");\n\n-- 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 知识使用日志表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_usage_logs (\n    ",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 知识点收藏表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 技术包装材料表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_packaging_materials (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    material_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 技术推广策略表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

{\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setProject(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadSources = async () =&gt;         "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    logo_url TEXT,\n    country TEXT,\n    founded_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 车型表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 车系表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\n    description TEXT,\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\n);\n\n-- 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nconstructor() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // SQLite 需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n          if (error?.message?.includes('already exists') || \n              error?.message?.includes('duplicate') ||\n              error?.code === 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT') {\n            console.warn('表或索引可能已存在，继续执行:', error.message);\n            continue;\n          }\n          throw error;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 文件存储表\n-- 用于存储上传的文件信息，支持后续反复调用\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 文件唯一标识\n  original_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 原始文件名\n  stored_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 存储的文件名\n  file_path TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件存储路径\n  file_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件访问URL\n  mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件MIME类型\n  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 文件大小（字节）\n  file_hash TEXT, -- 文件哈希值（用于去重）\n  category TEXT DEFAULT 'general', -- 文件分类（general, document, image等）\n  tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储标签\n  description TEXT, -- 文件描述\n  uploader_id TEXT, -- 上传者ID\n  conversation_id TEXT, -- 关联的对话ID（可选）\n  usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 使用次数\n  last_used_at DATETIME, -- 最后使用时间\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n  metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）\n2. Dify工作流执行表（INTEGER主键，包含workflow_run_id、task_id等）\n\n**解决方案**：\n- 合并为统一表，使用TEXT主键\n- 添加&#96;execution_type&#96;字段区分类型\n- 包含两种类型的所有字段，根据类型使用相应字段\n\n### 3.2 主键类型规范\n\n- **核心业务表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT（brands, car_models, tech_points等）\n- **配置表**：使用TEXT（UUID或自定义ID）（ai_roles, agent_workflows等）\n- **关联表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT\n\n### 3.3 命名规范\n\n- **表名**：使用复数形式（tech_points而非tech_point）\n- **字段名**：统一使用snake_case\n- **索引名**：统一格式&#96;idx_表名_字段名&#96;\n\n### 3.4 JSON字段存储\n\n复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：\n- &#96;dify_config&#96; - Dify配置",

{
  "contents": "import sqlite3 from 'sqlite3';\nimport { promisify } from 'util';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport fs from 'fs';\nimport { DatabaseManager, getDatabaseConfig } from '../config/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * 从 TPD2 数据库直接导入技术点数据到当前项目\n * \n * 使用方法：\n * 1. 确保 TPD2 数据库文件路径正确（默认：/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/backend/data/todify2.db）\n * 2. 运行: npx ts-node backend/src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts\n */\n\ninterface TechCategoryRow {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  parent_id?: number;\n  level: number;\n  sort_order: number;\n  status: string;\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n}\n\ninterface TechPointRow {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  category_id?: number;\n  parent_id?: number;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: string;\n  priority: string;\n  status: string;\n  tags?: string;\n  technical_details?: string;\n  benefits?: string;\n  applications?: string;\n  keywords?: string;\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n}\n\nclass TPD2DataImporter {\n  private tpd2DbPath: string;\n  private tpd2Db: sqlite3.Database | null = null;\n  private targetDb: DatabaseManager;\n\n  constructor(tpd2DbPath: string) {\n    this.tpd2DbPath = tpd2DbPath;\n    this.targetDb = new DatabaseManager();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 连接到 TPD2 数据库\n   */\n  async connectTPD2(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      if (!fs.existsSync(this.tpd2DbPath)) {\n        reject(new Error(&#96;TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&#96;));\n        return;\n      }\n\n      this.tpd2Db = new sqlite3.Database(this.tpd2DbPath, (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('连接 TPD2 数据库失败:', err);\n          reject(err);\n        } else {\n          logger.info(&#96;✅ 成功连接到 TPD2 数据库: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&#96;);\n          resolve();\n        }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查询 TPD2 数据库\n   */\n  private async queryTPD2(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    if (!this.tpd2Db) {\n      throw new Error('TPD2 数据库未连接');\n    }\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      this.tpd2Db!.all(sql, params, (err, rows) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('TPD2 数据库查询失败:', err);\n          reject(err);\n        } else {\n          resolve(rows);\n        }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 779
}

AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId,\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\n      implementationDate || null,\n      notes || null\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result[0];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &gt; 0 : true;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新车型关联信息\n   */\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\n    techPointId: number,\n    carModelId: number,\n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \n      SET \n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      applicationStatus,\n      implementationDate,\n      notes,\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? result[0] : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 解析JSON字段\n   */\n  private parseJsonFields(row: any): any {\n    if (!row) return row;\n    \n    const jsonFields = ['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'];\n    const parsed = { ...row };\n    \n    jsonFields.forEach(field =&gt; {\n      if (parsed[field] &amp;&amp; typeof parsed[field] === 'string') {\n        try {\n          parsed[field] = JSON.parse(parsed[field]);\n        } catch (e) {\n          // 如果解析失败，保持原值\n        }\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return parsed;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\n   */\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n    // 获取技术包装材料\n    const packagingSql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? \n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取推广策略\n    const promotionSql = &#96;\n      SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\n      JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取通稿\n    const pressSql = &#96;\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取演讲稿\n    const speechSql = &#96;\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \n      FROM tech_speeches sp\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n\n    const [packagingResult, promotionResult, pressResult, speechResult] = await Promise.all([\n      this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId])\n    ]);\n\n    return {\n      packagingMaterials: packagingResult,\n      promotionStrategies: promotionResult,\n      pressReleases: pressResult,\n      speeches: speechResult\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT cm.*, tcm.application_status, tcm.implementation_date, tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY cm.brand, cm.series, cm.model\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

        "contents": "export class TechPointController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   */\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      console.log('TechPointController.getAll called with query:', req.query);\n      \n      const {\n        page = 1,\n        pageSize = 20,\n        orderBy = 'created_at',\n        orderDirection = 'DESC',\n        status,\n        category_id,\n        parent_id,\n        tech_type,\n        priority\n      } = req.query;\n\n      const options = {\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n        where: {} as any\n      };\n\n      if (status) {\n        options.where.status = status;\n      }\n      if (category_id) {\n        options.where.category_id = parseInt(category_id as string);\n      }\n      if (parent_id !== undefined) {\n        options.where.parent_id = parent_id === 'null' ? null : parseInt(parent_id as string);\n      }\n      if (tech_type) {\n        options.where.tech_type = tech_type;\n      }\n      if (priority) {\n        options.where.priority = priority;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Query options:', options);\n      \n      const result = await techPointModel.findAll(options);\n      console.log('Query result:', result);\n      \n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: result\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Get tech points error:', error);\n      console.error('Error stack:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : 'Unknown error');\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取技术点列表失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据分类获取技术点\n   */\n  async getByCategoryId(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\nrouter.get('/tech-point/:techPointId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const techPointId = parseInt(req.params.techPointId);\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 10;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n\n    if (isNaN(techPointId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的技术点ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC'\n    };\n\n    const result = await knowledgePointService.getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(techPointId, options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取知识点列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取知识点列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据ID获取知识点详情\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "async importTechPointResources(): Promise&lt;{\n    imported: number;\n    skipped: number;\n    errors: number;\n  }&gt; {\n;\n\n      for (const assoc of associations) {\n        try {\n          // 检查关联是否已存在\n          const existing = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM tech_point_resources WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND resource_id = ?',\n            [assoc.tech_point_id, assoc.resource_id]\n          );\n\n          // 检查技术点和资源是否存在\n          const techPointExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?',\n            [assoc.tech_point_id]\n          );\n          const resourceExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM resources WHERE id = ?',\n            [assoc.resource_id]\n          );\n\n          if (!techPointExists || techPointExists.length === 0) {\n            logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${assoc.tech_point_id} 不存在，跳过关联&#96;);\n            stats.skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          if (!resourceExists || resourceExists.length === 0) {\n            logger.debug(&#96;资源 ${assoc.resource_id} 不存在，跳过关联&#96;);\n            stats.skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.length &gt; 0) {\n            stats.skipped++;\n          } else {\n            await this.targetDb.query(\n              &#96;INSERT INTO tech_point_resources (\n                tech_point_id, resource_id, created_at\n              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?)&#96;,\n              [\n                assoc.tech_point_id,\n                assoc.resource_id,\n                assoc.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),\n              ]\n            );\n            stats.imported++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;导入技术点与资源关联失败 (tech_point_id: ${assoc.tech_point_id}, resource_id: ${assoc.resource_id}):&#96;, error);\n          stats.errors++;\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info(&#96;技术点与资源关联导入完成: 新增 ${stats.imported} 个, 更新 ${stats.skipped} 个, 错误 ${stats.errors} 个&#96;);\n      return stats;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('导入技术点与资源关联失败:', error);\n  }",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\n   */\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n    // 获取技术包装材料\n    const packagingSql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? \n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取推广策略\n    const promotionSql = &#96;\n      SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\n      JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取通稿\n    const pressSql = &#96;\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    // 获取演讲稿\n    const speechSql = &#96;\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \n      FROM tech_speeches sp\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n\n    const [packagingResult, promotionResult, pressResult, speechResult] = await Promise.all([\n      this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId])\n    ]);\n\n    return {\n      packagingMaterials: packagingResult,\n      promotionStrategies: promotionResult,\n      pressReleases: pressResult,\n      speeches: speechResult\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT cm.*, tcm.application_status, tcm.implementation_date, tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY cm.brand, cm.series, cm.model\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 知识点收藏表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 技术包装材料表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_packaging_materials (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    material_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 技术推广策略表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据分类ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findByCategoryId(categoryId: number, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;TechPoint[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ContentConcatenationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 批量获取知识点数据以提高性能\n   */\n  private async batchGetKnowledgePointData(knowledgePointIds: string[]): Promise&lt;Map&lt;string, { associatedContent: any; techPointInfo: any }&gt;&gt; {\n    const result = new Map&lt;string, { associatedContent: any; techPointInfo: any }&gt;();\n    \n    // 并行获取所有知识点的数据\n    const promises = knowledgePointIds.map(async (id) =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const numericId = parseInt(id, 10);\n        const [associatedContent, techPointInfo] = await Promise.all([\n          this.techPointModel.getAssociatedContent(numericId),\n          this.techPointModel.findById(numericId)\n        ]);\n        return { id, associatedContent, techPointInfo };\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;批量获取知识点 ${id} 数据失败:&#96;, error);\n        return { id, associatedContent: null, techPointInfo: null };\n      }\n    });\n    \n    const results = await Promise.all(promises);\n    \n    results.forEach(({ id, associatedContent, techPointInfo }) =&gt; {\n      result.set(id, { associatedContent, techPointInfo });\n    });\n    \n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 按知识点ID分组选择项\n   */\n  private groupByKnowledgePoint(selectedItems: SelectionItem[]): Map&lt;string, SelectionItem[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    // 检查是否已存在关联\n    const existingSql = &#96;\n      SELECT id FROM tech_point_car_models \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId,\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\n      implementationDate || null,\n      notes || null\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result[0];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 过滤检索信息：排除上传的文件，只显示真正的检索信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\n  const filteredSources = sources.filter(source =&gt; {\n    // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的，不是http链接）\n    if (source.url &amp;&amp; !source.url.startsWith('http') &amp;&amp; !source.url.startsWith('https')) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    // 只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源\n    return true;\n  }).filter(source =&gt;\n    source.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\n    source.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredTechPoints = techPoints.filter(tp =&gt;\n    tp.name.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    tp.description?.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredKnowledgePoints = knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&gt;\n    kp.title.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    kp.content?.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const filteredPublicFiles = publicKnowledgeFiles.filter(file =&gt;\n    file.name.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\n    file.description?.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase())\n  );\n\n  const toggleTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedTechPoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(techPointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== techPointId)\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (knowledgePointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =&gt;\n      prev.includes(knowledgePointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== knowledgePointId)\n        : [...prev, knowledgePointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "### 3. 配置管理\n\n#### 3.1 后端环境变量配置\n创建 &#96;/root/todify2-deploy/backend/.env&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# 服务器端口配置\nPORT=3003\n\n# Dify API基础URL\nDIFY_BASE_URL=http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\nDIFY_WORKFLOW_BASE_URL=http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\n\n# Dify 应用 API 密钥\nAI_SEARCH_API_KEY=app-t1X4eu8B4eucyO6IfrTbw1t2\nTECH_PACKAGE_API_KEY=app-YDVb91faDHwTqIei4WWSNaTM\nTECH_STRATEGY_API_KEY=app-awRZf7tKfvC73DEVANAGGNr8\nTECH_ARTICLE_API_KEY=app-3TK9U2F3WwFP7vOoq0Ut84KA\nTECH_PUBLISH_API_KEY=app-WcV5IDjuNKbOKIBDPWdb7HF4\n\n# 数据库配置\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify3.db\nNODE_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3.2 前端配置\n确保 &#96;frontend/src/services/configService.ts&#96; 中的API URL指向后端代理：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// 所有API URL都应该使用8088端口代理\napiUrl: \"http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/dify/chat-messages\"\napiUrl: \"http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/dify/workflows/run\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3.3 Nginx配置\n创建 &#96;/etc/nginx/sites-available/todify2&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;nginx\nserver {\n    listen 8088;\n    server_name 47.113.225.93;\n\n    # 前端代理到3001端口\n    location / {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:3001;\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n\n        # WebSocket支持\n        proxy_http_version 1.1;\n        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;\n        proxy_set_header Connection \"upgrade\";\n    }\n\n    # API代理到3003端口\n    location /api/ {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:3003/api/;\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. 服务启动\n\n#### 4.1 启动后端服务\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/backend\nnpm run dev &gt; backend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4.2 构建并启动前端服务\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/frontend\nnpm run build\nnpm run dev &gt; frontend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4.3 启动Nginx",

        "contents": "# Todify3 部署问题解决知识库\n\n## 🚨 紧急问题快速解决\n\n### 1. 服务无法启动\n\n#### 问题现象\n- 端口无法监听\n- 进程启动失败\n- 服务无响应\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查端口占用\nlsof -i :3001\nlsof -i :3003\nlsof -i :8088\n\n# 检查进程状态\nps aux | grep node\nps aux | grep nginx\n\n# 检查日志\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/backend/backend.log\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/frontend/frontend.log\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **端口冲突**: 杀死占用进程或更换端口\n2. **权限问题**: 检查文件权限和用户权限\n3. **依赖缺失**: 重新安装npm依赖\n4. **配置错误**: 检查.env文件和配置文件\n\n### 2. API 404错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Failed to load resource: 404&#96;\n- API端点无法访问\n- 代理路由失效\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查路由注册\ncurl http://localhost:3003/api/health\ncurl http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/health\n\n# 检查Nginx配置\nnginx -t\nsystemctl status nginx\n\n# 检查后端路由\ngrep -r \"app.use\" /root/todify2-deploy/backend/src/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **路由未注册**: 检查&#96;index.ts&#96;中的路由注册\n2. **Nginx配置错误**: 检查代理配置\n3. **路径错误**: 检查API路径配置\n4. **服务未启动**: 重启相关服务\n\n### 3. CORS错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Access to fetch at ... has been blocked by CORS policy&#96;\n- 跨域请求失败\n- API调用被阻止\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查前端API配置\ngrep -r \"apiUrl\" /root/todify2-deploy/frontend/src/services/\n\n# 检查后端CORS配置\ngrep -r \"cors\" /root/todify2-deploy/backend/src/\n\n# 测试直接API调用\ncurl -X POST http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"query\":\"test\"}'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 解决方案\n1. **使用代理**: 前端通过后端代理调用API\n2. **CORS配置**: 检查后端CORS中间件\n3. **URL配置**: 确保API URL指向代理地址\n4. **头部设置**: 检查请求头配置\n\n### 4. 超时错误\n\n#### 问题现象\n- &#96;Request timeout after 30000ms&#96;\n- &#96;fetchError: Request timeout&#96;\n- API调用超时\n\n#### 快速诊断\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Todify3 部署检查清单\n\n## 📋 部署前检查\n\n### 环境准备\n- [ ] 服务器操作系统确认 (Ubuntu/CentOS)\n- [ ] Node.js 版本确认 (v18+)\n- [ ] Nginx 安装确认\n- [ ] 网络端口开放确认 (8088)\n- [ ] 磁盘空间充足 (至少10GB)\n\n### 代码准备\n- [ ] 项目代码完整上传\n- [ ] 前端代码 (&#96;frontend/&#96; 目录)\n- [ ] 后端代码 (&#96;backend/&#96; 目录)\n- [ ] Nginx配置文件 (&#96;nginx-proxy.conf&#96;)\n- [ ] 部署脚本 (&#96;quick-deploy.sh&#96;)\n\n## 🔧 配置检查\n\n### 后端配置\n- [ ] &#96;.env&#96; 文件创建\n- [ ] &#96;PORT=3003&#96; 设置正确\n- [ ] Dify API URL 配置正确\n- [ ] API 密钥配置完整\n- [ ] 数据库路径配置正确\n\n### 前端配置\n- [ ] &#96;configService.ts&#96; API URL 指向8088端口\n- [ ] 所有Dify配置使用代理URL\n- [ ] 超时设置合理 (120秒/90秒)\n\n### Nginx配置\n- [ ] 配置文件创建 (&#96;/etc/nginx/sites-available/todify2&#96;)\n- [ ] 前端代理到3001端口\n- [ ] API代理到3003端口\n- [ ] WebSocket支持配置\n\n## 🚀 部署执行\n\n### 依赖安装\n- [ ] 前端依赖安装 (&#96;npm install&#96;)\n- [ ] 后端依赖安装 (&#96;npm install&#96;)\n- [ ] 依赖安装无错误\n\n### 服务启动\n- [ ] 后端服务启动 (端口3003)\n- [ ] 前端服务启动 (端口3001)\n- [ ] Nginx服务启动 (端口8088)\n- [ ] 所有服务监听0.0.0.0\n\n### 服务管理\n- [ ] 服务管理脚本创建\n- [ ] 自动启动配置\n- [ ] 进程监控设置\n\n## ✅ 功能验证\n\n### 基础功能\n- [ ] 前端页面正常加载\n- [ ] 路由跳转正常\n- [ ] 静态资源加载正常\n\n### API功能\n- [ ] 健康检查API正常 (&#96;/api/health&#96;)\n- [ ] Dify聊天代理正常 (&#96;/api/dify/chat-messages&#96;)\n- [ ] Dify工作流代理正常 (&#96;/api/dify/workflows/run&#96;)\n\n### 核心功能\n- [ ] AI问答功能正常\n- [ ] 智能搜索功能正常\n- [ ] 技术包装功能正常\n- [ ] 技术策略功能正常\n- [ ] 技术通稿功能正常\n- [ ] 演讲稿生成功能正常\n\n### 统计功能\n- [ ] 工作流统计页面正常\n- [ ] 数据收集功能正常\n- [ ] 图表渲染正常\n\n## 🔍 性能检查",

        "contents": "# 智能工作流统计系统部署指南\n\n## 🚀 快速部署\n\n### 1. 环境准备\n\n确保已安装以下环境：\n- Node.js 16+\n- npm 或 yarn\n- SQLite3\n\n### 2. 数据库初始化\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 进入后端目录\ncd backend\n\n# 安装依赖\nnpm install\n\n# 初始化统计数据库表\nnpx ts-node src/scripts/init-workflow-stats.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 启动服务\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 启动后端服务（终端1）\ncd backend\nnpm run dev\n\n# 启动前端服务（终端2）\ncd frontend\nnpm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. 访问系统\n\n- **统计页面**: http://localhost:3000/workflow-stats\n- **API接口**: http://localhost:3001/api/workflow-stats\n- **健康检查**: http://localhost:3001/api/health\n\n## 📊 功能验证\n\n### 1. 检查数据库表\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 进入后端目录\ncd backend\n\n# 检查表是否创建成功\nnpx ts-node -e \"\nimport { DatabaseManager } from './src/config/database';\nconst db = new DatabaseManager();\ndb.query('SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\\\"table\\\" AND name LIKE \\\"%workflow%\\\"')\n  .then(result =&gt; console.log('统计表:', result))\n  .catch(err =&gt; console.error(err));\n\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 测试API接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 测试统计概览接口\ncurl http://localhost:3001/api/workflow-stats/overview\n\n# 测试健康检查接口\ncurl http://localhost:3001/api/health\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 验证前端页面\n\n访问 http://localhost:3000/workflow-stats 查看统计页面是否正常显示。\n\n## 🔧 配置说明\n\n### 环境变量配置\n\n在 &#96;backend/.env&#96; 文件中配置：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# 数据库配置\nDB_TYPE=sqlite\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/unified.db\n\n# API配置\nPORT=3001\nNODE_ENV=development\n\n# 统计配置\nSTATS_ENABLED=true\nSTATS_RETENTION_DAYS=90\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 前端配置\n\n在 &#96;frontend/.env&#96; 文件中配置：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api\nREACT_APP_STATS_ENABLED=true\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📈 集成现有节点\n\n### 1. 在节点组件中添加统计收集\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { statsCollector } from '../utils/statsCollector';\n\nconst MyNodeComponent = () =&gt; {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    ",

        "contents": "# 🚀 Dify 文件上传快速测试指南\n\n## 快速开始\n\n### 1. 启动前端服务\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd frontend\nnpm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n前端服务会在 &#96;http://localhost:3001&#96; 启动\n\n### 2. 访问测试页面\n\n在浏览器中打开：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhttp://localhost:3001/dify-test.html\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 配置 Dify API\n\n在页面顶部填写：\n- **Dify API Base URL**: &#96;http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1&#96;\n- **API Key**: 您的 Dify API Key（从 Dify 后台获取）\n- **App ID**: &#96;2c112aca-151b-418d-9c93-8c07160829e9&#96;\n\n### 4. 测试步骤\n\n1. **选择文件**\n   - 点击\"选择文件\"按钮\n   - 选择一个 PDF 文件（例如：&#96;【final】2025上海车展一页纸核心信息.pdf&#96;）\n\n2. **发送消息**\n   - 在消息输入框中输入：&#96;请分析这个文件的内容&#96;\n   - 点击\"发送消息\"按钮\n\n3. **观察日志**\n   - 查看页面底部的\"操作日志\"区域\n   - 应该看到：\n     - ✅ &#96;开始上传文件: xxx.pdf&#96;\n     - ✅ &#96;文件上传成功: xxx.pdf -&gt; file-xxx&#96;（包含文件 ID）\n     - ✅ &#96;发送消息，包含 1 个文件 ID: file-xxx&#96;\n     - ✅ &#96;收到响应&#96;（包含 AI 回复）\n\n4. **验证结果**\n   - 检查 AI 回复是否引用了文件内容\n   - 检查对话记录中是否显示文件 ID\n\n## ✅ 成功标志\n\n如果看到以下日志，说明文件上传和传递成功：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n[时间] 开始上传文件: xxx.pdf\n[时间] 文件上传成功: xxx.pdf -&gt; file-123-456\n[时间] 文件上传完成: 1/1 成功\n[时间] 发送消息，包含 1 个文件 ID: file-123-456\n[时间] 收到响应: {...}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## ❌ 常见问题\n\n### 问题 1: 文件上传失败\n\n**错误信息**: &#96;上传失败: 401&#96; 或 &#96;上传失败: 403&#96;\n\n**解决方法**:\n- 检查 API Key 是否正确\n- 确认 API Key 有文件上传权限\n\n### 问题 2: 消息发送失败\n\n**错误信息**: &#96;请求失败: 400&#96; 或 &#96;请求失败: 404&#96;\n\n**解决方法**:\n- 检查 App ID 是否正确\n- 检查 Dify API Base URL 是否正确\n\n### 问题 3: AI 回复未引用文件\n\n**可能原因**:\n- Chatflow 配置问题\n- 文件输入字段未启用\n\n**解决方法**:",

        "contents": "import type { ApiResponse, ApiErrorPayload } from '@/shared/types/api';\n\nclass ApiClient {\n  private readonly client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1',\n      timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.request.use((config) =&gt; {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');\n      if (token) {\n        config.headers = {\n          ...config.headers,\n          Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;,\n        };\n      }\n      return config;\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; response,\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 处理超时错误\n        if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {\n          const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n            code: 'TIMEOUT_ERROR',\n            message: '请求超时，请稍后重试。AI处理可能需要较长时间，请耐心等待。',\n            details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n          };\n          return Promise.reject(apiError);\n        }\n\n        const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n          code: error.response?.data?.error?.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message || '请求失败',\n          details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n        };\n\n        return Promise.reject(apiError);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  private unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response: AxiosResponse&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;): ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "ENDSSH\n    \n    log_success \"前端服务配置完成\"\n}\n\n# 配置 Nginx\nsetup_nginx() {\n    log_info \"配置 Nginx...\"\n    \n    sshpass -p \"$SERVER_PASSWORD\" ssh $SSH_OPTIONS $SERVER_USER@$SERVER_IP &lt;&lt; ENDSSH\n        set -e\n        \n        # 创建 Nginx 配置\n        cat &gt; /etc/nginx/sites-available/${SERVICE_NAME} &lt;&lt; EOFNGINX\nserver {\n    listen ${EXTERNAL_PORT};\n    server_name ${SERVER_IP};\n    \n    # 前端代理\n    location / {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:${FRONTEND_PORT};\n        proxy_set_header Host \\$host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP \\$remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For \\$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto \\$scheme;\n        \n        # WebSocket 支持\n        proxy_http_version 1.1;\n        proxy_set_header Upgrade \\$http_upgrade;\n        proxy_set_header Connection \"upgrade\";\n        \n        # 超时设置\n        proxy_connect_timeout 120s;\n        proxy_send_timeout 120s;\n        proxy_read_timeout 120s;\n    }\n    \n    # API 代理到后端\n    location /api/ {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:${BACKEND_PORT}/api/;\n        proxy_set_header Host \\$host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP \\$remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For \\$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto \\$scheme;\n        \n        # 超时设置\n        proxy_connect_timeout 120s;\n        proxy_send_timeout 120s;\n        proxy_read_timeout 120s;\n    }\n    \n    # Metrics 端点\n    location /metrics {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:${BACKEND_PORT}/metrics;\n        proxy_set_header Host \\$host;\n    }\n}\nEOFNGINX\n        \n        # 创建符号链接\n        ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/${SERVICE_NAME} /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/${SERVICE_NAME}\n        \n        # 测试 Nginx 配置\n        nginx -t\n        \n        # 重载 Nginx\n        systemctl reload nginx || service nginx reload\n        \n        echo \"✅ Nginx 配置完成\"\nENDSSH\n    \n    log_success \"Nginx 配置完成\"\n}\n\n# 验证部署",

        "contents": "**解决方案**:\n- 后端: &#96;app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\")&#96;\n- 前端: &#96;vite.config.ts&#96; 添加 &#96;host: \"0.0.0.0\"&#96;\n\n## 📊 验证检查清单\n\n### 服务状态检查\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查端口监听\nnetstat -tulnp | grep -E ':(3001|3003|8088)'\n\n# 检查API健康状态\ncurl http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/health\n\n# 检查Dify代理\ncurl -X POST http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/dify/chat-messages \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"appType\":\"default-ai-search\",\"query\":\"测试\",\"inputs\":{}}'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 功能测试\n- [ ] 前端页面正常加载\n- [ ] AI问答功能正常\n- [ ] 工作流功能正常\n- [ ] 统计页面正常\n- [ ] API代理正常\n\n## 🚨 常见问题排查\n\n### 1. 服务无法启动\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 检查端口占用\nlsof -i :3001\nlsof -i :3003\n\n# 检查日志\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/backend/backend.log\ntail -f /root/todify2-deploy/frontend/frontend.log\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. API 404错误\n- 检查后端路由注册\n- 检查Nginx代理配置\n- 检查API路径是否正确\n\n### 3. CORS错误\n- 确认前端使用后端代理URL\n- 检查后端CORS中间件配置\n\n### 4. 超时错误\n- 检查Dify服务响应时间\n- 调整前端超时设置\n- 检查网络连接\n\n## 📈 性能优化建议\n\n### 1. 前端优化\n- 启用代码分割\n- 优化打包体积\n- 使用CDN加速静态资源\n\n### 2. 后端优化\n- 启用压缩中间件\n- 优化数据库查询\n- 添加缓存机制\n\n### 3. 部署优化\n- 使用PM2管理进程\n- 配置负载均衡\n- 监控服务状态\n\n## 🔄 更新部署流程\n\n### 1. 代码更新\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 停止服务\n/root/todify2-deploy/manage-service.sh stop\n\n# 更新代码\ncd /root/todify2-deploy\n# 上传新代码文件\n\n# 重新安装依赖（如有需要）\ncd frontend &amp;&amp; npm install\ncd ../backend &amp;&amp; npm install\n\n# 重新构建前端\ncd frontend &amp;&amp; npm run build\n\n# 启动服务\n/root/todify2-deploy/manage-service.sh start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 配置更新\n- 更新环境变量\n- 更新Nginx配置\n- 重启相关服务\n\n## 📝 维护日志\n\n### 部署记录\n- **部署时间**: 2025-10-24\n- **版本**: v1.0.0\n- **主要修复**: CORS问题、超时问题、端口冲突",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "**解决方案**:",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "- 后端: &#96;app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\")&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "- 前端: &#96;vite.config.ts&#96; 添加 &#96;host: \"0.0.0.0\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 验证检查清单",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "### 服务状态检查",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

AI搜索接口\n\n**端点**: &#96;POST /ai-search&#96;\n\n**描述**: 调用Dify的AI搜索聊天消息API，用于智能问答和搜索功能。\n\n**请求参数**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"query\": \"string (必需) - 搜索查询内容\",\n  \"inputs\": {\n    \"key\": \"value (可选) - 额外的输入参数\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**响应格式**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"event\": \"string - 事件类型\",\n    \"task_id\": \"string - 任务ID\",\n    \"id\": \"string - 消息ID\",\n    \"message_id\": \"string - 消息唯一标识\",\n    \"conversation_id\": \"string - 会话ID\",\n    \"mode\": \"string - 模式\",\n    \"answer\": \"string - AI回答内容\",\n    \"metadata\": {\n      \"usage\": {\n        \"prompt_tokens\": 0,\n        \"completion_tokens\": 0,\n        \"total_tokens\": 0,\n        \"total_price\": \"string - 总价格\",\n        \"currency\": \"string - 货币单位\",\n        \"latency\": 0\n      },\n      \"retriever_resources\": [\n        {\n          \"position\": 1,\n          \"dataset_id\": \"string - 数据集ID\",\n          \"dataset_name\": \"string - 数据集名称\",\n          \"document_id\": \"string - 文档ID\",\n          \"document_name\": \"string - 文档名称\",\n          \"segment_id\": \"string - 片段ID\",\n          \"score\": 0.95,\n          \"content\": \"string - 检索内容\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    \"created_at\": 0\n  },\n  \"message\": \"AI搜索完成\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**示例请求**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:3001/ai-search \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\n    \"query\": \"什么是人工智能？\",\n    \"inputs\": {\n      \"language\": \"zh-CN\"\n    }\n  }'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 技术包装接口\n\n**端点**: &#96;POST /tech-package&#96;\n\n**描述**: 调用技术包装应用，用于技术内容的包装和优化。\n\n**请求参数**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"inputs\": {\n    ",

        "contents": "    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 检查 TypeScript 编译工具\nif ! command -v ts-node-dev &amp;&gt; /dev/null &amp;&amp; [ ! -f \"node_modules/.bin/ts-node-dev\" ]; then\n    echo \"⚠️  警告: ts-node-dev 未找到，尝试安装...\"\n    npm install ts-node-dev --save-dev\nfi\n\n# 启动服务并捕获 PID\necho \"🚀 正在启动后端服务...\"\nPORT=$BACKEND_PORT npm run dev &gt; \"$BACKEND_LOG\" 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\nBACKEND_PID=$!\n\n# 等待一小段时间让进程启动\nsleep 5\n\n# 检查进程是否还在运行\nif ! kill -0 $BACKEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ 后端服务启动失败，进程已退出\"\n    echo \"📋 查看日志:\"\n    cat \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"💡 常见问题排查:\"\n    echo \"   1. 检查端口 $BACKEND_PORT 是否被占用: lsof -i :$BACKEND_PORT\"\n    echo \"   2. 检查数据库文件权限\"\n    echo \"   3. 检查 .env 文件配置\"\n    echo \"   4. 检查 node_modules 是否完整: cd backend &amp;&amp; npm install\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 等待后端启动\necho \"⏳ 等待后端服务启动...\"\nif wait_for_service \"http://localhost:$BACKEND_PORT/api/health\" \"$BACKEND_LOG\" \"$BACKEND_PID\"; then\n    echo \"✅ 后端服务启动成功\"\nelse\n    echo \"❌ 后端服务启动失败或超时\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"📋 查看完整日志 (最后 50 行):\"\n    tail -50 \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"📋 查看进程状态:\"\n    ps aux | grep -E \"node|ts-node\" | grep -v grep || echo \"未找到相关进程\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"💡 诊断建议:\"\n    echo \"   1. 检查端口 $BACKEND_PORT 是否被占用: lsof -i :$BACKEND_PORT\"\n    echo \"   2. 检查数据库连接: 查看日志中的数据库错误\"\n    echo \"   3. 检查环境变量: cat backend/.env\"\n    echo \"   4. 手动启动测试: cd backend &amp;&amp; PORT=$BACKEND_PORT npm run dev\"\n    echo \"\"\n    kill $BACKEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 启动前端服务\necho \"🎨 启动前端服务 (端口: $FRONTEND_PORT)...\"\ncd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend\"\nnpm run dev &gt; /tmp/frontend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\nFRONTEND_PID=$!\n\n# 等待前端启动\nsleep 3\n\necho \"\"\necho \"==========================================\"\necho \"🎉 Todify3 启动完成!\"\necho \"==========================================\"",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "├── 📄 AI问答.yml                 # AI问答工作流配置\n├── 📄 AI问答-技术包装2.yml        # AI问答技术包装工作流\n├── 📄 DIFY_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md   # Dify集成计划\n├── 📄 DIFY_FIELD_MAPPING.md      # Dify字段映射\n└── 📄 ！dify对接快速指南.md        # Dify对接指南\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 📋 其他文档\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nguide/\n├── 📄 API_DOCUMENTATION.md       # API接口文档\n├── 📄 demand.md                  # 需求文档\n├── 📄 product-document.md        # 产品文档\n├── 📄 project-document.md        # 项目文档\n├── 📄 technical-document.md      # 技术文档\n├── 📄 three-tier-design.md       # 三层架构设计\n├── 📄 ui-ux-design.md           # UI/UX设计文档\n└── 📄 ！R.md                     # 其他说明文档\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔄 核心调用关系\n\n### 🎯 前端组件调用链\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmain.tsx → App.tsx → 路由页面 → 具体组件\n    ↓\nWorkflowPage → 工作流节点展示\n    ↓\nNodePage → 动态加载节点组件 (TechPackageNode, AiSearchNode等)\n    ↓\n节点组件 → 调用services/api.ts → 后端API\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 🔧 后端API调用链\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nindex.ts → routes/index.ts → 具体路由文件 → controllers → services → models\n    ↓\n中间件处理 → 路由匹配 → 控制器处理 → 业务逻辑 → 数据库操作\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 📊 数据流向\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n前端组件 → API服务 → 后端路由 → 控制器 → 服务层 → 数据模型 → 数据库\n    ↑                                                                    ↓\n响应数据 ← JSON格式 ← 处理结果 ← 业务逻辑 ← 数据查询 ← SQL操作 ← 数据存储\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 启动流程\n\n### 开发环境启动\n1. **后端服务**: &#96;cd backend &amp;&amp; npm run dev&#96; (端口: 8000)\n2. **前端应用**: &#96;cd frontend &amp;&amp; npm run dev -- --port 3001&#96; (端口: 3001)\n3. **一键启动**: 执行根目录的 &#96;start.sh&#96; 脚本\n\n### 核心依赖关系\n- **前端**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Radix UI",

        "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# Todify3 完整部署脚本\n# 服务配置：\n# - 服务名：todify3\n# - 对外端口：8089（Nginx）\n# - 前端本地端口：2201\n# - 后端本地端口：2203（PM2）\n\nset -e\n\n# 设置颜色输出\nRED='\\033[0;31m'\nGREEN='\\033[0;32m'\nYELLOW='\\033[1;33m'\nBLUE='\\033[0;34m'\nNC='\\033[0m' # No Color\n\n# 日志函数\nlog_info() {\n    echo -e \"${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nlog_success() {\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nlog_warning() {\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nlog_error() {\n    echo -e \"${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\n# 服务器配置\nSERVER_IP=\"47.113.225.93\"\nSERVER_USER=\"root\"\nSERVER_PASSWORD=\"Qb89100820\"\nDEPLOY_PATH=\"/root/todify3\"\nBACKEND_PATH=\"${DEPLOY_PATH}/backend\"\nFRONTEND_PATH=\"${DEPLOY_PATH}/frontend\"\nSSH_OPTIONS=\"-o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null\"\n\n# 端口配置\nEXTERNAL_PORT=\"8089\"\nFRONTEND_PORT=\"2201\"\nBACKEND_PORT=\"2203\"\nSERVICE_NAME=\"todify3\"\n\n# 获取脚本所在目录\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" &amp;&amp; pwd)\"\nPROJECT_ROOT=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" &amp;&amp; pwd)\"\n\n# 检查本地工具\ncheck_local_tools() {\n    log_info \"检查本地工具...\"\n    \n    if ! command -v sshpass &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n        log_error \"未找到 sshpass 工具\"\n        echo \"请安装 sshpass：\"\n        echo \"  macOS:   brew install hudochenkov/sshpass/sshpass\"\n        echo \"  Ubuntu:  sudo apt-get install sshpass\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    if ! command -v node &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n        log_error \"未找到 Node.js\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    if ! command -v npm &amp;&gt; /dev/null; then\n        log_error \"未找到 npm\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\n    \n    log_success \"本地工具检查完成\"\n}\n\n# 构建前端\nbuild_frontend() {\n    log_info \"构建前端...\"",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 重载 Nginx 配置\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'nginx -t &amp;&amp; systemctl reload nginx'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 访问地址\n\n- **前端访问**: http://47.113.225.93:8089\n- **API 健康检查**: http://47.113.225.93:8089/api/health\n- **Metrics 端点**: http://47.113.225.93:8089/metrics\n\n## 注意事项\n\n1. **不影响现有服务**: 部署脚本只会操作 &#96;todify3&#96; 相关的服务，不会影响其他正在运行的服务。\n\n2. **数据库备份**: 每次同步数据库前，脚本会自动备份云端现有数据库到 &#96;backend/data/backup/&#96; 目录。\n\n3. **端口冲突**: 确保服务器上的端口 2201、2203 和 8089 没有被其他服务占用。\n\n4. **环境变量**: 部署脚本会自动更新 &#96;.env&#96; 文件中的端口配置为 2203，并设置 &#96;NODE_ENV=production&#96;。\n\n5. **PM2 开机自启**: 部署脚本会自动配置 PM2 开机自启，确保服务在服务器重启后自动启动。\n\n## 故障排查\n\n### 服务无法启动\n\n1. 检查端口是否被占用：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'netstat -tlnp | grep -E \":2201|:2203|:8089\"'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. 查看 PM2 日志：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'pm2 logs todify3-backend --lines 50'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. 检查数据库连接：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'ls -lh /root/todify3/backend/data/'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Nginx 配置问题\n\n1. 测试 Nginx 配置：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'nginx -t'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. 查看 Nginx 错误日志：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 数据库同步问题\n\n1. 检查本地数据库文件是否存在：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nls -lh backend/data/*.db\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. 检查云端数据库文件：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'ls -lh /root/todify3/backend/data/'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 文件结构\n\n部署后的服务器文件结构：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/root/todify3/",
        "signatures": {},
