        "contents": "echo \"==========================================\"\necho \"🎉 Todify3 启动完成!\"\necho \"==========================================\"\necho \"📱 前端地址: http://localhost:$FRONTEND_PORT\"\necho \"🔧 后端地址: http://localhost:$BACKEND_PORT\"\necho \"\"\necho \"📋 日志文件:\"\necho \"   后端: $BACKEND_LOG\"\necho \"   前端: /tmp/frontend.log\"\necho \"\"\necho \"💡 提示: 使用以下命令查看实时日志:\"\necho \"   tail -f $BACKEND_LOG\"\necho \"   tail -f /tmp/frontend.log\"\necho \"\"\necho \"按 Ctrl+C 停止所有服务\"\necho \"==========================================\"\n\n# 捕获 Ctrl+C 信号\ntrap 'echo \"\"; echo \"🛑 正在停止服务...\"; kill $BACKEND_PID $FRONTEND_PID 2&gt;/dev/null; echo \"✅ 服务已停止\"; exit 0' INT\n\n# 等待进程结束\nwait",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "# Todify3 部署说明\n\n## 部署配置\n\n- **服务名**: todify3\n- **对外端口**: 8089 (通过 Nginx 反向代理)\n- **前端本地端口**: 2201\n- **后端本地端口**: 2203 (使用 PM2 管理)\n- **服务器**: 47.113.225.93\n\n## 快速部署\n\n### 完整部署（首次部署或更新代码）\n\n运行完整部署脚本，会自动完成以下操作：\n1. 构建前端\n2. 上传项目文件到服务器\n3. 同步数据库和配置文件\n4. 安装依赖\n5. 配置 PM2 启动后端服务\n6. 配置前端服务\n7. 配置 Nginx 反向代理\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/todify3\n./scripts/deploy-todify3.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 仅同步数据库（不重新部署代码）\n\n如果只需要同步本地数据库到云端，可以使用数据库同步脚本：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/todify3\n./scripts/sync-database-to-cloud.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n此脚本会：\n1. 备份云端现有数据库\n2. 同步本地数据库文件到云端\n3. 同步 .env 配置文件\n4. 同步上传文件目录\n5. 可选：重启服务以应用更改\n\n## 服务管理\n\n### 查看服务状态\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'pm2 status'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 查看服务日志\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 后端日志\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'pm2 logs todify3-backend'\n\n# 前端日志\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'pm2 logs todify3-frontend'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 重启服务\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'pm2 restart todify3-backend todify3-frontend'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 停止服务\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'pm2 stop todify3-backend todify3-frontend'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 查看 Nginx 状态\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'systemctl status nginx'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 重载 Nginx 配置\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsshpass -p 'Qb89100820' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@47.113.225.93 'nginx -t &amp;&amp; systemctl reload nginx'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 访问地址\n\n- **前端访问**: http://47.113.225.93:8089",
        "signatures": {},

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "#### 4.2 构建并启动前端服务\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/frontend\nnpm run build\nnpm run dev &gt; frontend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4.3 启动Nginx\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nsudo nginx -t  # 测试配置\nsudo systemctl reload nginx\nsudo systemctl enable nginx\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. 服务管理\n\n#### 5.1 创建服务管理脚本\n创建 &#96;/root/todify2-deploy/manage-service.sh&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n#!/bin/bash\n\ncase \"$1\" in\n    start)\n        echo \"启动Todify3服务...\"\n        cd /root/todify2-deploy/backend &amp;&amp; npm run dev &gt; backend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n        cd /root/todify2-deploy/frontend &amp;&amp; npm run dev &gt; frontend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n        echo \"服务启动完成\"\n        ;;\n    stop)\n        echo \"停止Todify3服务...\"\n        pkill -f \"node.*backend\"\n        pkill -f \"node.*frontend\"\n        echo \"服务停止完成\"\n        ;;\n    restart)\n        echo \"重启Todify3服务...\"\n        $0 stop\n        sleep 2\n        $0 start\n        ;;\n    status)\n        echo \"检查服务状态...\"\n        netstat -tulnp | grep -E ':(3001|3003|8088)'\n        ;;\n    *)\n        echo \"用法: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}\"\n        exit 1\n        ;;\nesac\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 5.2 设置自动启动\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 添加到crontab\ncrontab -e\n\n# 添加以下行：\n@reboot /root/todify2-deploy/manage-service.sh start\n*/1 * * * * /root/todify2-deploy/manage-service.sh status\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🔧 关键修复点\n\n### 1. CORS问题解决\n**问题**: 前端直接调用Dify API导致CORS错误\n**解决方案**: \n- 创建后端代理路由 &#96;backend/src/routes/dify-proxy.ts&#96;\n- 前端配置改为通过后端代理访问\n- 后端统一管理API密钥\n\n### 2. 超时问题解决\n**问题**: 请求30秒超时\n**解决方案**:\n- &#96;callDifyAPI&#96;: 设置120秒超时\n- &#96;callDifyWorkflowAPI&#96;: 设置90秒超时\n- 使用 &#96;AbortController&#96; 实现超时控制\n\n### 3. 端口冲突解决\n**问题**: 端口3002被Dify服务占用\n**解决方案**: 后端服务改为使用3003端口\n\n### 4. 服务监听地址修复\n**问题**: 服务只监听IPv6，Nginx无法连接\n**解决方案**:\n- 后端: &#96;app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\")&#96;\n- 前端: &#96;vite.config.ts&#96; 添加 &#96;host: \"0.0.0.0\"&#96;",

        "contents": "main() {\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"==========================================\"\n    echo \"🚀 Todify3 完整部署脚本\"\n    echo \"==========================================\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"服务配置：\"\n    echo \"  - 服务名: ${SERVICE_NAME}\"\n    echo \"  - 对外端口: ${EXTERNAL_PORT}\"\n    echo \"  - 前端端口: ${FRONTEND_PORT}\"\n    echo \"  - 后端端口: ${BACKEND_PORT}\"\n    echo \"  - 服务器: ${SERVER_USER}@${SERVER_IP}\"\n    echo \"\"\n    \n    # 确认操作\n    read -p \"是否继续部署？(y/n) \" -n 1 -r\n    echo\n    if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then\n        log_info \"部署已取消\"\n        exit 0\n    fi\n    \n    # 执行部署步骤\n    check_local_tools\n    build_frontend\n    check_server_connection\n    install_server_tools\n    upload_project\n    sync_database_and_config\n    install_server_dependencies\n    setup_pm2\n    setup_frontend\n    setup_nginx\n    verify_deployment\n    \n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"==========================================\"\n    log_success \"部署完成！\"\n    echo \"==========================================\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"🌐 访问地址: http://${SERVER_IP}:${EXTERNAL_PORT}\"\n    echo \"🔧 API 地址: http://${SERVER_IP}:${EXTERNAL_PORT}/api/health\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"📋 服务管理命令：\"\n    echo \"  查看服务状态:\"\n    echo \"    sshpass -p '${SERVER_PASSWORD}' ssh ${SSH_OPTIONS} ${SERVER_USER}@${SERVER_IP} 'pm2 status'\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"  查看日志:\"\n    echo \"    sshpass -p '${SERVER_PASSWORD}' ssh ${SSH_OPTIONS} ${SERVER_USER}@${SERVER_IP} 'pm2 logs ${SERVICE_NAME}-backend'\"\n    echo \"\"\n    echo \"  重启服务:\"\n    echo \"    sshpass -p '${SERVER_PASSWORD}' ssh ${SSH_OPTIONS} ${SERVER_USER}@${SERVER_IP} 'pm2 restart ${SERVICE_NAME}-backend ${SERVICE_NAME}-frontend'\"\n    echo \"\"\n}\n\n# 执行主函数\nmain \"$@\"",

        "contents": "# Todify3 项目部署标准指南\n\n## 📋 概述\n\n本文档记录了Todify3项目的完整部署过程，包括问题排查、修复方案和最佳实践，为后续部署提供标准化指导。\n\n## 🏗️ 项目架构\n\n### 服务架构\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n用户访问 (8088端口)\n    ↓\nNginx 反向代理\n    ↓\n┌─────────────────┬─────────────────┐\n│   前端服务       │   后端服务       │\n│   (3001端口)     │   (3003端口)     │\n│   React + Vite   │   Express + TS   │\n└─────────────────┴─────────────────┘\n    ↓\nDify API 代理\n    ↓\nDify 服务 (9999端口)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 技术栈\n- **前端**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS\n- **后端**: Node.js + Express + TypeScript + SQLite\n- **代理**: Nginx (反向代理)\n- **AI服务**: Dify API (外部服务)\n\n## 🚀 部署流程\n\n### 1. 环境准备\n\n#### 1.1 服务器要求\n- **操作系统**: Ubuntu/CentOS\n- **内存**: 至少 2GB\n- **存储**: 至少 10GB\n- **网络**: 公网IP，开放8088端口\n\n#### 1.2 软件依赖\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 安装Node.js (推荐v18+)\ncurl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | sudo -E bash -\nsudo apt-get install -y nodejs\n\n# 安装Nginx\nsudo apt-get update\nsudo apt-get install -y nginx\n\n# 安装其他工具\nsudo apt-get install -y git curl wget\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 代码部署\n\n#### 2.1 上传代码\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 创建部署目录\nsudo mkdir -p /root/todify2-deploy\ncd /root/todify2-deploy\n\n# 上传项目文件 (使用scp或其他方式)\n# 确保包含以下目录结构：\n# ├── frontend/          # 前端代码\n# ├── backend/           # 后端代码\n# ├── nginx-proxy.conf   # Nginx配置\n# └── deploy.sh          # 部署脚本\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2.2 安装依赖\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 安装前端依赖\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/frontend\nnpm install\n\n# 安装后端依赖\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/backend\nnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 配置管理\n\n#### 3.1 后端环境变量配置",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "        fi\n    fi\n}\n\n# 获取脚本所在目录\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" &amp;&amp; pwd)\"\n\n# 安装后端依赖\ninstall_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\" \"后端\"\n\n# 修复后端依赖兼容性问题\nfix_backend_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\"\n\n# 检查后端 .env 文件\nif [ ! -f \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/.env\" ]; then\n    echo \"⚠️  警告: 后端 .env 文件不存在\"\n    echo \"   创建默认 .env 文件...\"\n    cat &gt; \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/.env\" &lt;&lt; EOF\n# 服务器端口配置\nPORT=3003\n\n# 数据库配置\nDB_TYPE=sqlite\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify2.db\n\n# 服务器配置\nNODE_ENV=development\nEOF\n    echo \"✅ 已创建默认 .env 文件，请根据需要修改配置\"\nfi\n\n# 安装前端依赖\ninstall_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend\" \"前端\"\n\n# 检查前端是否缺少 reactflow\nif [ ! -d \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend/node_modules/reactflow\" ]; then\n    echo \"📥 安装缺失的 reactflow 依赖...\"\n    cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend\"\n    npm install reactflow\nfi\n\necho \"🎯 启动服务...\"\n\n# 启动后端服务\necho \"🔧 启动后端服务 (端口: $BACKEND_PORT)...\"\ncd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\"\n\n# 确保数据库目录存在\nif [ -f \".env\" ]; then\n    # 从 .env 文件中读取数据库路径\n    DB_PATH=$(grep \"^SQLITE_DB_PATH=\" .env | cut -d '=' -f2 | tr -d '\"' | tr -d \"'\" | xargs || echo \"./data/todify2.db\")\n    # 如果路径是相对路径，确保相对于 backend 目录\n    if [[ \"$DB_PATH\" != /* ]]; then\n        DB_PATH=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/$DB_PATH\"\n    fi\n    DB_DIR=$(dirname \"$DB_PATH\")\n    if [ ! -d \"$DB_DIR\" ]; then\n        echo \"📁 创建数据库目录: $DB_DIR\"\n        mkdir -p \"$DB_DIR\"\n    fi\n    echo \"📂 数据库路径: $DB_PATH\"\nfi\n\n# 确保日志文件存在\nBACKEND_LOG=\"/tmp/backend.log\"\ntouch \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n\n# 清理旧的日志文件\n&gt; \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n\n# 检查必要的依赖\necho \"🔍 检查后端依赖...\"\nif [ ! -d \"node_modules\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ 后端依赖未安装，请先运行 npm install\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 检查 TypeScript 编译工具\nif ! command -v ts-node-dev &amp;&gt; /dev/null &amp;&amp; [ ! -f \"node_modules/.bin/ts-node-dev\" ]; then\n    ",

{
  "contents": "import axios, { AxiosInstance, AxiosRequestConfig, AxiosResponse } from 'axios';\n\nimport type { ApiResponse, ApiErrorPayload } from '@/shared/types/api';\n\nclass ApiClient {\n  private readonly client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1',\n      timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.request.use((config) =&gt; {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');\n      if (token) {\n        config.headers = {\n          ...config.headers,\n          Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;,\n        };\n      }\n      return config;\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; response,\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 处理超时错误\n        if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {\n          const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n            code: 'TIMEOUT_ERROR',\n            message: '请求超时，请稍后重试。AI处理可能需要较长时间，请耐心等待。',\n            details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n          };\n          return Promise.reject(apiError);\n        }\n\n        const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n          code: error.response?.data?.error?.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message || '请求失败',\n          details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n        };\n\n        return Promise.reject(apiError);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  private unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response: AxiosResponse&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;): ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n    if (response.data) {\n      return response.data;\n    }\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: {\n        code: 'EMPTY_RESPONSE',\n        message: '接口返回内容为空',\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  async get&lt;T&gt;(url: string, config?: AxiosRequestConfig): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await this.client.get&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;(url, config);\n    return this.unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response);\n  }\n\n  async post&lt;T&gt;(url: string, data?: unknown, config?: AxiosRequestConfig): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await this.client.post&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;(url, data, config);\n    return this.unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response);\n  }\n\n  async put&lt;T&gt;(url: string, data?: unknown, config?: AxiosRequestConfig): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await this.client.put&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;(url, data, config);\n    return this.unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response);\n  }\n\n  async delete&lt;T&gt;(url: string, config?: AxiosRequestConfig): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await this.client.delete&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;(url, config);\n    return this.unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response);\n  }\n}\n\nexport const apiClient = new ApiClient();\n\n",

}

typeof performanceMonitor.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(performanceMonitor.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('性能监控中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// Prometheus 指标中间件（放在性能监控之后）\nif (prometheusMetrics &amp;&amp; typeof prometheusMetrics.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(prometheusMetrics.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('Prometheus 指标中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// 添加请求日志中间件（放在最前面，但要在路由之前）\napp.use((req, res, next) =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      context: { metadata: { token: req.params.token } },\n    });\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n      data: null\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 公开访问接口（通过address获取配置和角色）\napp.get('/api/v1/public-by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&gt; error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      context: { metadata: { address: req.params.address } },\n    });\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n      data: null\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 公开访问接口（通过configId获取配置和角色）\napp.get('/api/v1/public-config/:configId', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { configId } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(configId);\n    \n    if (!config || !config.isActive) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\n    }\n\n    // 获取角色列表\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        try {\n          const workflowNodes = typeof workflow.nodes === 'string' \n            ? JSON.parse(workflow.nodes) \n            : workflow.nodes;\n          if (Array.isArray(workflowNodes)) {\n            const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n            const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n            roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n          }\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析工作流节点失败', { \n            workflowId: config.workflowId, \n            error: parseError \n          });\n          // 解析失败时返回空角色列表，不抛出错误\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      context: { metadata: { configId: req.params.configId } },\n    });\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n      data: null\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// API 健康检查\napp.get('/api/health', (req, res) =&gt; {\n  res.json({ \n    message: 'Todify3 Backend API',\n    version: '1.0.0',\n    status: 'running',\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    uptime: process.uptime(),\n  });\n});\n\n// 性能监控 API\napp.get('/api/v1/monitoring/performance', (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const stats = performanceMonitor.getStats();\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: stats,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      error: {\n        code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',\n        message: '获取性能统计失败',\n      },\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// Prometheus 指标端点\napp.get('/metrics', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    res.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8');\n    const metrics = await prometheusMetrics.getMetrics();\n    res.send(metrics);\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\n    res.status(500).send('# Error generating metrics\\n');\n  }\n});\n\n// 公共知识库文件服务\nconst publicKnowledgeUploadDir = path.join(__dirname, '../uploads/public-knowledge');\napp.use('/api/v1/public-knowledge/files', express.static(publicKnowledgeUploadDir, {\n  maxAge: 86400000, // 1 day\n  etag: true,\n  lastModified: true,\n}));\n\n// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\nif (!isDev) {\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\n    maxAge: 0,\n    etag: true,\n    lastModified: true,\n  }));\n\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\n  app.get(/^(\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&gt; {\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\n  });\n}\n\n// 全局错误处理中间件\n// 注意：这个中间件必须放在所有路由之后，且必须有4个参数 (err, req, res, next)\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&gt; {\n  // 如果响应已经发送，则委托给默认的 Express 错误处理\n  if (res.headersSent) {\n    return next(err);\n  }\n\n  // 记录错误详情\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\n    error: err,\n    stack: err?.stack,\n    requestUrl: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    method: req.method,\n    path: req.path,\n    body: req.body,\n    params: req.params,\n    query: req.query,\n  });\n\n  // 发送到错误追踪\n  errorTracking.captureException(\n    err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),\n    {\n      context: {\n        metadata: {\n          method: req.method,\n          path: req.path,\n          body: req.body,\n          params: req.params,\n          query: req.query,\n        },\n      },\n    }\n  );\n\n  // 根据错误类型返回不同的状态码\n  const statusCode = err.statusCode || err.status || 500;\n  const errorMessage =\n    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'\n      ? '服务器内部错误'\n      : err.message || 'Unknown error';\n\n  res.status(statusCode).json({\n    success: false,\n    message: 'Internal server error',\n    error: errorMessage,\n    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &amp;&amp; { stack: err?.stack }),\n  });\n});\n\n// 启动服务器前测试数据库连接\nasync function startServer() {\n  try {\n    logger.info('正在测试数据库连接...');\n    const isConnected = await testConnection();\n    if (!isConnected) {\n      throw new Error('数据库连接失败');\n    }\n    logger.info('数据库连接成功');\n    \n    // 初始化AI角色数据库表\n    try {\n      const { aiRoleModel } = await import('./models');\n      await aiRoleModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('AI角色数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('AI角色数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化Agent工作流数据库表\n    try {\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      await agentWorkflowModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('Agent工作流数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('Agent工作流数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化公开页面配置数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicPageConfigModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicPageConfigModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公开页面配置数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公开页面配置数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化来源信息数据库表\n    try {\n      const sourceInformationService = new SourceInformationService();\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('来源信息数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('来源信息数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\n    try {\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\n    }\n    \n    const server = app.listen(port, \"0.0.0.0\", () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&#96; });\n    });\n\n    // 保持进程运行\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\n\n    // 优雅关闭处理\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    process.on('SIGINT', () =&gt; {\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\n      server.close(() =&gt; {\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\n        process.exit(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    return server;\n  } catch (error) {\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      level: 'fatal',\n    });\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nstartServer();",

tableCheck.length &gt; 0) {\n        const resourcesSql = &#96;\n          SELECT r.*, tr.created_at as association_created_at\n          FROM resources r\n          JOIN tech_point_resources tr ON r.id = tr.resource_id\n          WHERE tr.tech_point_id = ?\n          ORDER BY tr.created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        resourcesResult = await this.db.query(resourcesSql, [techPointId]);\n        \n        // 解析 attachments JSON 字段\n        resourcesResult = resourcesResult.map(resource =&gt; {\n          if (resource.attachments &amp;&amp; typeof resource.attachments === 'string') {\n            try {\n              resource.attachments = JSON.parse(resource.attachments);\n            } catch (e) {\n              // 解析失败，保持原值\n            }\n          }\n          return resource;\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 如果查询失败（表不存在等），返回空数组\n      console.warn('获取技术点关联资源失败:', error);\n    }\n\n    const [packagingResult, promotionResult, pressResult, speechResult] = await Promise.all([\n      this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]),\n      this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId])\n    ]);\n\n    return {\n      packagingMaterials: packagingResult,\n      promotionStrategies: promotionResult,\n      pressReleases: pressResult,\n      speeches: speechResult,\n      resources: resourcesResult\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT cm.*, tcm.application_status, tcm.implementation_date, tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY cm.brand_id, cm.name\n    &#96;;\n    \n    return await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    // 检查是否已存在关联\n    const existingSql = &#96;\n      SELECT id FROM tech_point_car_models \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId,\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\n      implementationDate || null,\n      notes || null\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result[0];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &gt; 0 : true;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新车型关联信息\n   */\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\n    techPointId: number,\n    carModelId: number,\n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \n      SET \n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      applicationStatus,\n      implementationDate,\n      notes,\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? result[0] : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 解析JSON字段\n   */\n  private parseJsonFields(row: any): any {\n    if (!row) return row;\n    \n    const jsonFields = ['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'];\n    const parsed = { ...row };\n    \n    jsonFields.forEach(field =&gt; {\n      if (parsed[field] &amp;&amp; typeof parsed[field] === 'string') {\n        try {\n          parsed[field] = JSON.parse(parsed[field]);\n        } catch (e) {\n          // 如果解析失败，保持原值\n        }\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return parsed;\n  }\n}",
  "totalLinesInFile": 611
}

AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId,\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\n      implementationDate || null,\n      notes || null\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result[0];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      DELETE FROM tech_point_car_models \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    // 对于DELETE操作，检查是否有行被影响\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &gt; 0 : true;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新车型关联信息\n   */\n  async updateCarModelAssociation(\n    techPointId: number,\n    carModelId: number,\n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_point_car_models \n      SET \n        application_status = COALESCE(?, application_status),\n        implementation_date = COALESCE(?, implementation_date),\n        notes = COALESCE(?, notes),\n        updated_at = datetime('now')\n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      if (!fs.existsSync(this.tpd2DbPath)) {\n        reject(new Error(&#96;TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&#96;));\n        return;\n      }\n\n      this.tpd2Db = new sqlite3.Database(this.tpd2DbPath, (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('连接 TPD2 数据库失败:', err);\n          reject(err);\n        } else {\n          logger.info(&#96;✅ 成功连接到 TPD2 数据库: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&#96;);\n          resolve();\n        }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查询 TPD2 数据库\n   */\n  private async queryTPD2(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    if (!this.tpd2Db) {\n      throw new Error('TPD2 数据库未连接');\n    }\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      this.tpd2Db!.all(sql, params, (err, rows) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('TPD2 数据库查询失败:', err);\n          reject(err);\n        } else {\n          resolve(rows);\n        }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * 技术点同步服务\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\n * \n * 后续实现功能：\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\n * 5. 同步日志记录\n */\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\n  /**\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n   * @param options 同步选项\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量（总数）\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync', {\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\n      });\n      // 后端返回的格式是 { success, message, data: { total, created, updated, errors } }\n      if (response.data &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        const stats = response.data.data;\n        return {\n          success: response.data.success ?? true,\n          data: {\n            synced: stats.total || (stats.created || 0) + (stats.updated || 0),\n            updated: stats.updated || 0,\n            created: stats.created || 0,\n            errors: stats.errors || 0,\n          },\n          message: response.data.message,\n        };\n      }\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\n   */\n,\n};",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "class TPD2DataImporter {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行完整导入流程\n   */\n  async import(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 连接数据库\n      await this.connectTPD2();\n      await this.targetDb.connect();\n\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('开始从 TPD2 导入数据');\n      logger.info('========================================');\n\n      // 1. 导入品牌（车型的前置依赖）\n      const brandStats = await this.importBrands();\n\n      // 2. 导入技术分类\n      const categoryStats = await this.importTechCategories();\n\n      // 3. 导入技术点\n      const techPointStats = await this.importTechPoints();\n\n      // 4. 导入车型（依赖品牌）\n      const carModelStats = await this.importCarModels();\n\n      // 5. 导入资源\n      const resourceStats = await this.importResources();\n\n      // 6. 导入技术点与车型关联\n      const carModelAssocStats = await this.importTechPointCarModels();\n\n      // 7. 导入技术点与资源关联\n      const resourceAssocStats = await this.importTechPointResources();\n\n      // 输出汇总\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('数据导入完成');\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('品牌:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${brandStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${brandStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${brandStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术分类:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${categoryStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${categoryStats.skipped}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${categoryStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术点:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${techPointStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${techPointStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${techPointStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('车型:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${carModelStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${carModelStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${carModelStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('资源:');\n  }\n}",

};\n\n    try {\n      const tableExists = await this.tableExistsTPD2('tech_point_resources');\n      if (!tableExists) {\n        logger.warn('TPD2 数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，跳过资源关联导入');\n        return stats;\n      }\n\n      // 检查目标数据库中是否有 tech_point_resources 表\n      const targetTableExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n        \"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='tech_point_resources'\"\n      );\n\n      if (!targetTableExists || targetTableExists.length === 0) {\n        logger.warn('目标数据库中不存在 tech_point_resources 表，创建表结构...');\n        await this.targetDb.query(&#96;\n          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_resources (\n            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n            tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n            UNIQUE(tech_point_id, resource_id)\n          )\n        &#96;);\n        logger.info('✅ tech_point_resources 表创建成功');\n      }\n\n      logger.info('开始导入技术点与资源关联...');\n      const associations = await this.queryTPD2('SELECT * FROM tech_point_resources ORDER BY tech_point_id, resource_id');\n\n      if (associations.length === 0) {\n        logger.info('TPD2 数据库中没有技术点与资源关联数据');\n        return stats;\n      }\n\n      logger.info(&#96;找到 ${associations.length} 个技术点与资源关联&#96;);\n\n      for (const assoc of associations) {\n        try {\n          // 检查关联是否已存在\n          const existing = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM tech_point_resources WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND resource_id = ?',\n            [assoc.tech_point_id, assoc.resource_id]\n          );\n\n          // 检查技术点和资源是否存在\n          const techPointExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?',\n            [assoc.tech_point_id]\n          );\n          const resourceExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM resources WHERE id = ?',\n            [assoc.resource_id]\n          );\n\n          if (!techPointExists || techPointExists.length === 0) {\n            logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${assoc.tech_point_id} 不存在，跳过关联&#96;);\n            stats.skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          if (!resourceExists || resourceExists.length === 0) {\n            logger.debug(&#96;资源 ${assoc.resource_id} 不存在，跳过关联&#96;);\n            stats.skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          if (existing &amp;&amp; 数据已成功导入并同步。总结如下：

## 已完成的修复

### 1. **后端修复**
   - 修复了 `getAssociatedCarModels` 的 SQL 排序字段错误
   - 在 `getAssociatedContent` 中添加了资源查询逻辑
   - 改进了错误处理，确保查询失败不影响其他数据

### 2. **数据导入脚本修复**
   - 修改为完全同步模式：先清空关联数据，再重新导入
   - 自动跳过无效关联（技术点或车型不存在的情况）
   - 成功导入 22 个有效的技术点与车型关联
   - 成功导入 1 个技术点与资源关联

### 3. **数据验证**
   - 当前项目有 22 个技术点与车型关联（涉及 16 个技术点、7 个车型）
   - API 正常返回关联数据：
     - `/api/v1/tech-points/6/car-models` 返回车型数据
     - `/api/v1/tech-points/36/content` 返回资源数据

### 说明
TPD2 数据库中有 67 个关联记录，但其中 45 个关联引用了不存在的车型 ID（11-23），这些是无效数据，已在导入时跳过。当前项目中只导入了 22 个有效关联，这是正确的。

2. 查看 Network 面板中的 API 响应
3. 确认前端代码已重新构建（如使用 Vite，会自动热更新）

        "contents": "const CarModelDetail: React.FC&lt;CarModelDetailProps&gt; = ({\n  carModel,\n  onClose,\n  onEdit,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&lt;TechPoint[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string&gt;(\"\");\n  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState&lt;\n    Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;\n  &gt;({\n    basic: true,\n    specs: true,\n    techPoints: true,\n  });\n\n  // 获取关联的技术点\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const fetchTechPoints = async () =&gt; {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(\"\");\n\n      try {\n        const response = await carModelService.getTechPoints(carModel.id);\n        setTechPoints(response.data || []);\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(\"获取关联技术点失败\");\n        console.error(\"Error fetching tech points:\", err);\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    fetchTechPoints();\n  }, [carModel.id]);\n\n  // 切换展开/收起状态\n  const toggleSection = (section: string) =&gt; {\n    setExpandedSections((prev) =&gt; ({\n      ...prev,\n      [section]: !prev[section],\n    }));\n  };\n\n  // 格式化状态显示\n  const getStatusDisplay = (status: CarModelStatus) =&gt; {\n    const statusMap = {\n      [CarModelStatus.ACTIVE]: {\n        text: \"在产\",\n        color: \"bg-green-100 text-green-800\",\n      },\n      [CarModelStatus.DISCONTINUED]: {\n        text: \"停产\",\n        color: \"bg-red-100 text-red-800\",\n      },\n      [CarModelStatus.PLANNED]: {\n        text: \"计划中\",\n        color: \"bg-blue-100 text-blue-800\",\n      },\n    };\n    return (\n      statusMap[status] || { text: status, color: \"bg-gray-100 text-gray-800\" }\n    );\n  };\n\n  // 格式化技术点类型\n  const getTechPointTypeBadge = (type: string)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "// 技术点相关类型定义\nimport { CarModel } from './carModel';\n\nexport interface TechPoint {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  features?: string; // 技术特性（从technology_versions迁移）\n  version?: string; // 版本号（从technology_versions迁移）\n  release_date?: string; // 发布日期（从technology_versions迁移）\n  technology_id?: number; // 关联的技术IP（从technology_versions迁移）\n  category_id: number;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: TechType; // 统一使用tech_type与后端保持一致\n  priority: TechPriority;\n  status: TechStatus;\n  tags?: string[];\n  technical_details?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  benefits?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  applications?: string[];\n  keywords?: string[];\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  tech_principle?: string; // 技术原理\n  tech_value?: string; // 价值\n  tech_boundary?: string; // 适用边界\n  highlights?: string[]; // 技术亮点列表\n  evidence_measured?: string[]; // 证据-实测列表\n  evidence_certified?: string[]; // 证据-认证列表\n  evidence_comparison?: string[]; // 证据-对比列表\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n  category?: TechCategory;\n}\n\nexport interface TechCategory {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ?         "contents": "const CarSeriesEditPage: React.FC = \nconst [editingCompetitor, setEditingCompetitor] = &lt;Competitor | null&gt;(\n    null,\n  );\n\n  // 加载车系数据\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadCarSeries = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!id) return;\n\n      try {\n        setLoading(true);\n        const response = await carSeriesService.getById(parseInt(id));\n\n        if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n          const series = response.data;\n          setCarSeries(series);\n\n          // 设置基本信息\n          setBasicInfo({\n            name: series.name,\n            description: series.description || \"\",\n            market_segment: series.market_segment || \"\",\n            launch_year: series.launch_year,\n            end_year: series.end_year,\n          });\n\n          // 解析metadata中的关键车型和竞争对手信息\n          if (series.metadata) {\n            const metadata =\n              typeof series.metadata === \"string\"\n                ? JSON.parse(series.metadata)\n                : series.metadata;\n\n            setKeyCarModels(metadata.keyCarModels || []);\n            setCompetitors(metadata.competitors || []);\n          }\n\n          // 加载关联的技术点\n          const techPointsResponse = await carSeriesService.getTechPoints(\n            parseInt(id),\n          );\n          if (techPointsResponse.success &amp;&amp; techPointsResponse.data) {\n            setAssociatedTechPoints(techPointsResponse.data);\n          }\n        } else {\n          setError(\"车系不存在或加载失败\");\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(\"加载车系信息失败\");\n        console.error(\"Load car series error:\", err);\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadCarSeries();\n  }, [id]);\n\n  // 加载可用技术点\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadTechPoints = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints();\n        if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n          setAvailableTechPoints(response.data.data || []);\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(\"Load tech points error:\", err);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadTechPoints();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 保存车系信息\n  const handleSave = async ()\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport {\n  KnowledgePoint,\n  CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  KnowledgePointQueryOptions,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/knowledgePoint';\n\nconst KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL = '/knowledge-points';\n\nexport const knowledgePointService = {\n  // 创建知识点\n  async create(data: CreateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post(KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options?: KnowledgePointQueryOptions\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const params = {\n      page: options?.page || 1,\n      pageSize: options?.pageSize || 10,\n      orderBy: options?.orderBy || 'created_at',\n      orderDirection: options?.orderDirection || 'DESC'\n    };\n    \n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/tech-point/${techPointId}&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点详情\n  async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  }\n};",

JSON.parse(series.metadata)\n                : series.metadata;\n\n            setKeyCarModels(metadata.keyCarModels || []);\n            setCompetitors(metadata.competitors || []);\n          }\n\n          // 加载关联的技术点\n          const techPointsResponse = await carSeriesService.getTechPoints(\n            parseInt(id),\n          );\n          if (techPointsResponse.success &amp;&amp; techPointsResponse.data) {\n            setAssociatedTechPoints(techPointsResponse.data);\n          }\n        } else {\n          setError(\"车系不存在或加载失败\");\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(\"加载车系信息失败\");\n        console.error(\"Load car series error:\", err);\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadCarSeries();\n  }, [id]);\n\n  // 加载可用技术点\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadTechPoints = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints();\n        if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n          setAvailableTechPoints(response.data.data || []);\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(\"Load tech points error:\", err);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadTechPoints();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 保存车系信息\n  const handleSave = async ()\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

{\n    switch (type) {\n      case 'feature':\n        return 'blue';\n      case 'performance':\n        return 'purple';\n      case 'safety':\n        return 'orange';\n      case 'comfort':\n        return 'cyan';\n      case 'improvement':\n        return 'cyan';\n      case 'innovation':\n        return 'purple';\n      case 'technology':\n        return 'geekblue';\n      default:\n        return 'default';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getReleaseStatusColor = (releaseStatus: string) =&gt; {\n    switch (releaseStatus) {\n      case '已发布':\n        return 'success';\n      case '待发布':\n        return 'warning';\n      case '未发布':\n        return 'default';\n      default:\n        return 'default';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleExportToPDF = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!detailContentRef.current) {\n      message.warning('无法导出，请稍后再试');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setExporting(true);\n    try {\n      await new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 500));\n\n      const element = detailContentRef.current;\n      const canvas = await html2canvas(element, {\n        scale: 2,\n        useCORS: true,\n        logging: false,\n        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',\n        width: element.scrollWidth,\n        height: element.scrollHeight,\n      });\n\n      const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');\n      const pdf = new jsPDF('p', 'mm', 'a4');\n      \n      const pdfWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();\n      const pdfHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();\n      const imgWidth = canvas.width;\n      const imgHeight = canvas.height;\n      \n      const ratio = pdfWidth / imgWidth;\n      const imgScaledWidth = imgWidth * ratio;\n      const imgScaledHeight = imgHeight * ratio;\n      \n      let heightLeft = imgScaledHeight;\n      let position = 0;\n\n      pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, position, imgScaledWidth, imgScaledHeight);\n      heightLeft -= pdfHeight;\n\n      while (heightLeft &gt; 0) {\n        position = heightLeft - imgScaledHeight;\n        pdf.addPage();\n        pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, position, imgScaledWidth, imgScaledHeight);\n        heightLeft -= pdfHeight;\n      }\n\n      const fileName = &#96;${currentTechPoint.name}_技术点详情_${dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss')}.pdf&#96;;\n      pdf.save(fileName);\n      message.success('导出PDF成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('导出PDF失败:', error);\n      message.error('导出PDF失败，请稍后再试');\n    } finally {\n      setExporting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleExportToJSON = () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const exportData = {\n        ...currentTechPoint,\n        technology_name: technologyName,\n        category_name: categoryName,\n        associated_car_models: associatedCarModels,\n        associated_resources: associatedResources,\n        export_time: dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'),\n      };\n\n      const jsonString = JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2);\n      const blob = new Blob([jsonString], { type: 'application/json' });\n      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const link = document.createElement('a');\n      link.href = url;\n      link.download = &#96;${currentTechPoint.name}_技术点详情_${dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss')}.json&#96;;\n      document.body.appendChild(link);\n      link.click();",

已对齐当前项目与 TPD2 项目的技术点详情页差异。总结已完成的修改：

## 已完成的差异对齐

### 1. **技术IP获取功能**
   - 添加了从 TPD2 API 获取技术IP信息的逻辑
   - 使用 `TPD_API_BASE_URL` 配置
   - 支持回退到本地 API（如果存在）

### 2. **知识点记录Card的extra属性**
   - 添加了 `extra={<Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: '12px' }}>管理技术点相关的知识点内容</Text>}`

### 3. **Modal标题中的release_status**
   - 添加了 `getReleaseStatusColor` 函数
   - 在 Modal 标题中显示 `release_status` 标签（如果存在）
   - 如果没有 `release_status`，则显示 `status` 标签

### 4. **知识点记录的数据获取优先级**
   - 改为优先使用技术点的独立字段（`highlights`, `evidence_measured` 等）
   - 如果没有独立字段，则使用解析的 `description`

### 5. **描述解析逻辑**
   - 对齐 TPD2 项目的简单单行解析逻辑
   - 列表项限制从 20 个改为 5 个（与 TPD2 一致）
   - 移除了多行内容累积逻辑，改为单行解析

### 6. **技术类型颜色映射**
   - 添加了 `performance`, `safety`, `comfort` 等类型的颜色映射

{\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      if (!fs.existsSync(this.tpd2DbPath)) {\n        reject(new Error(&#96;TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&#96;));\n        return;\n      }\n\n      this.tpd2Db = new sqlite3.Database(this.tpd2DbPath, (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('连接 TPD2 数据库失败:', err);\n          reject(err);\n        } else {\n          logger.info(&#96;✅ 成功连接到 TPD2 数据库: ${this.tpd2DbPath}&#96;);\n          resolve();\n        }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查询 TPD2 数据库\n   */\n  private async queryTPD2(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    if (!this.tpd2Db) {\n      throw new Error('TPD2 数据库未连接');\n    }\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      this.tpd2Db!.all(sql, params, (err, rows) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('TPD2 数据库查询失败:', err);\n          reject(err);\n        } else {\n          resolve(rows);\n        }\n      });\n    });\n  }\n",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

          },

        "contents": "export class TechCategoryModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 删除技术分类（软删除）\n   */\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有子分类\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\n    if (children.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with child categories');\n    }\n\n    // 检查是否有关联的技术点\n    const techPointsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_points WHERE category_id = ?';\n    const techPointsResult = await this.db.query(techPointsSql, [id]);\n    if (techPointsResult[0].count &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete category with associated tech points');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_categories \n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.INACTIVE, id]);\n    return result.affectedRows &gt; 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 物理删除技术分类\n   */\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有子分类\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "## 数据库表完整列表（20个）\n\n数据库文件: ./data/todify2.db\n\n### 核心配置表 (6个):\nagent_workflows - Agent工作流 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nai_roles - AI角色配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_templates - 工作流模板 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npublic_page_configs - 公开页面配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npage_tool_configs - 页面工具配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n\n### AI搜索相关表 (4个):\nai_search_conversations - AI搜索对话 [服务✅]\nai_search_messages - AI搜索消息 [服务✅]\nai_search_outputs - AI搜索输出 [服务✅]\nai_search_field_mappings - AI搜索字段映射 [服务✅]\n\n### 聊天对话表 (4个):\nconversations - 对话会话 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nchat_messages - 聊天消息 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nknowledge_usage_logs - 知识使用日志 [服务✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [服务✅ 路由✅] (与第3项重复)\n\n\n### 业务数据表 (5个):\nbrands - 品牌 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_models - 车型 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_series - 车系 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_categories - 技术分类 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_points - 技术点 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 文件和服务表 (2个):\nfiles - 文件存储 [服务✅]\nworkflow_stats_summary - 工作流统计 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 来源信息表 (1个):\nsource_information - 来源信息 [模型✅ 路由✅]",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    logo_url TEXT,\n    country TEXT,\n    founded_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 车型表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 车系表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\n    description TEXT,\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\n);\n\n-- 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

        "contents": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\n\n## 一、概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\n\n### 1.1 设计目标\n\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\n\n### 1.2 架构分层\n\n数据库架构分为五层：\n\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\n\n## 二、表结构设计\n\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\n\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\n\n存储汽车品牌信息。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\n\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本 (SQLite版本)\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  logo_url TEXT,\n  country TEXT,\n  founded_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 创建更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS brands_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON brands\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE brands SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 3. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 4. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT OR IGNORE INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  datetime('now'),\n  datetime('now')\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != '';\n\n-- 5. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nALTER TABLE car_models RENAME TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 7. 创建车型表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_models_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_models\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_models SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 知识点收藏表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 技术包装材料表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_packaging_materials (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    material_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 技术推广策略表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

      "codeBlock": {
