        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 3. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  NOW(),\n  NOW()\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != ''\nON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW();\n\n-- 4. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nRENAME TABLE car_models TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 5. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 1. 创建品牌表",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 2. 备份原有 car_models 表",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 3. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "INSERT INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "SELECT DISTINCT ",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  brand,",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  'active',",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  NOW(),",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  NOW()",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "FROM car_models",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "WHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != ''",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW();",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 4. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "RENAME TABLE car_models TO car_series_temp;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 5. 创建新的车型表",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE car_models (",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  brand_id INT NOT NULL,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "  INDEX idx_status (status)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 6. 创建新的车系表",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": "# 三层级车系架构设计\n\n## 概述\n将原有的两层级结构（品牌-车系）调整为三层级结构（品牌-车型-车系），以更好地反映汽车行业的实际层级关系。\n\n## 层级关系\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n品牌 (Brand)\n├── 车型 (Model) \n    ├── 车系 (Series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据库设计\n\n### 1. 品牌表 (brands)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE brands (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '品牌名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  logo_url VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '品牌logo',\n  country VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '品牌国家',\n  founded_year INT COMMENT '成立年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '品牌描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'inactive') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 车型表 (car_models)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  brand_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  category ENUM('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv') COMMENT '车型类别',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车型描述',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_brand_id (brand_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "// 技术点相关类型定义\nimport { CarModel } from './carModel';\n\nexport interface TechPoint {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  features?: string; // 技术特性（从technology_versions迁移）\n  version?: string; // 版本号（从technology_versions迁移）\n  release_date?: string; // 发布日期（从technology_versions迁移）\n  technology_id?: number; // 关联的技术IP（从technology_versions迁移）\n  category_id: number;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: TechType; // 统一使用tech_type与后端保持一致\n  priority: TechPriority;\n  status: TechStatus;\n  tags?: string[];\n  technical_details?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  benefits?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  applications?: string[];\n  keywords?: string[];\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  tech_principle?: string; // 技术原理\n  tech_value?: string; // 价值\n  tech_boundary?: string; // 适用边界\n  highlights?: string[]; // 技术亮点列表\n  evidence_measured?: string[]; // 证据-实测列表\n  evidence_certified?: string[]; // 证据-认证列表\n  evidence_comparison?: string[]; // 证据-对比列表\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n  category?: TechCategory;\n}\n\nexport interface TechCategory {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n;\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "// 技术点相关类型定义",

          {
            "text": "import { CarModel } from './carModel';",

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "/**\n * 主函数：创建所有缺失的表\n */\nasync function createMissingTables() {\n  try {\n    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════');\n    console.log('   创建缺失的数据库表');\n    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════');\n    console.log('');\n\n    await db.connect();\n    console.log('✅ 数据库连接成功\\n');\n\n    // 按顺序创建表（考虑外键依赖）\n    console.log('📝 开始创建缺失的表...\\n');\n\n    // 1. 品牌表（无依赖）\n    await createBrandsTable();\n\n    // 2. 车型和车系表（依赖brands）\n    await createCarTables();\n\n    // 3. 技术分类和技术点表（无外部依赖）\n    await createTechTables();\n\n    // 4. 页面工具配置表（无依赖）\n    await createPageToolConfigTable();\n\n    // 5. 工作流统计表（无依赖）\n    await createWorkflowStatsTables();\n\n    console.log('\\n🎉 所有缺失的表创建完成！');\n\n    // 验证创建结果\n    console.log('\\n📊 验证创建结果：');\n    const tablesToCheck = [\n      'brands',\n      'car_models',\n      'car_series',\n      'tech_categories',\n      'tech_points',\n      'page_tool_configs',\n      'workflow_stats_summary',\n    ];\n\n    for (const table of tablesToCheck) {\n      const exists = await tableExists(table);\n      if (exists) {\n        const count = await db.query(&#96;SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ${table}&#96;) as any[];\n        const recordCount = Array.isArray(count) &amp;&amp; count.length &gt; 0 ? count[0].count : 0;\n        console.log(&#96;   ✅ ${table}: 存在 (${recordCount} 条记录)&#96;);\n      } else {\n        console.log(&#96;   ❌ ${table}: 不存在&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ 创建表失败:', error);\n    throw error;\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n  }\n}\n\n// 如果直接运行此脚本\nif (require.main === module)",

==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    logo_url TEXT,\n    country TEXT,\n    founded_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 车型表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 车系表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\n    description TEXT,\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\n);\n\n-- 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    parent_id INTEGER,\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    category_id INTEGER,\n    parent_id INTEGER,\n    level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\n    technical_details TEXT, -- JSON格式存储技术细节\n    benefits TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储优势\n    applications TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储应用场景\n    keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储关键词\n    source_url VARCHAR(500),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第二层：关联关系层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)",

}

AND resource_id = ?',\n            [assoc.tech_point_id, assoc.resource_id]\n          );\n\n          // 检查技术点和资源是否存在\n          const techPointExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?',\n            [assoc.tech_point_id]\n          );\n          const resourceExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n            'SELECT id FROM resources WHERE id = ?',\n            [assoc.resource_id]\n          );\n\n          if (!techPointExists || techPointExists.length === 0) {\n            logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${assoc.tech_point_id} 不存在，跳过关联&#96;);\n            stats.skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          if (!resourceExists || resourceExists.length === 0) {\n            logger.debug(&#96;资源 ${assoc.resource_id} 不存在，跳过关联&#96;);\n            stats.skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          // 由于已经清空，直接插入所有关联\n          await this.targetDb.query(\n            &#96;INSERT INTO tech_point_resources (\n              tech_point_id, resource_id, created_at\n            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?)&#96;,\n            [\n              assoc.tech_point_id,\n              assoc.resource_id,\n              assoc.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),\n            ]\n          );\n          stats.imported++;\n          logger.debug(&#96;导入技术点与资源关联: tech_point_id=${assoc.tech_point_id}, resource_id=${assoc.resource_id}&#96;);\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;导入技术点与资源关联失败 (tech_point_id: ${assoc.tech_point_id}, resource_id: ${assoc.resource_id}):&#96;, error);\n          stats.errors++;\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info(&#96;技术点与资源关联导入完成: 新增 ${stats.imported} 个, 跳过 ${stats.skipped} 个（技术点或资源不存在）, 错误 ${stats.errors} 个&#96;);\n      return stats;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('导入技术点与资源关联失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 清空本地技术点数据（在导入前）\n   */\n  async clearLocalData(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('清空本地技术点数据');\n      logger.info('========================================');\n\n      const tables = [\n        'tech_point_resources',\n        'tech_point_car_models',\n        'tech_points',\n        'tech_categories',\n        'resources',\n        'car_models',\n        'brands',\n      ];\n\n      for (const table of tables) {\n        try {\n          const tableExists = await this.targetDb.query(\n            \"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?\",\n            [table]\n          );\n\n          if (!tableExists || tableExists.length === 0) {\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          const countResult = await this.targetDb.query(&#96;SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ${table}&#96;);\n          const count = countResult &amp;&amp; countResult.length &gt; 0 ? countResult[0].count : 0;\n\n          if (count &gt; 0) {\n            logger.info(&#96;清空表 ${table}（${count} 条记录）...&#96;);\n            await this.targetDb.query(&#96;DELETE FROM ${table}&#96;);\n            logger.info(&#96;✅ 已清空表 ${table}&#96;);\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          logger.warn(&#96;清空表 ${table} 失败:&#96;, error?.message || error);\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info('✅ 本地数据清空完成');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('清空本地数据失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行完整导入流程\n   */\n  async import(clearFirst: boolean = true): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 连接数据库\n      await this.connectTPD2();\n      await this.targetDb.connect();\n\n      // 如果需要，先清空本地数据\n      if (clearFirst) {\n        await this.clearLocalData();\n      }\n\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('开始从 TPD2 导入数据');\n      logger.info('========================================');\n\n      // 1. 导入品牌（车型的前置依赖）\n      const brandStats = await this.importBrands();\n\n      // 2. 导入技术分类\n      const categoryStats = await this.importTechCategories();\n\n      // 3. 导入技术点\n      const techPointStats = await this.importTechPoints();\n\n      // 4. 导入车型（依赖品牌）\n      const carModelStats = await this.importCarModels();\n\n      // 5. 导入资源\n      const resourceStats = await this.importResources();\n\n      // 6. 导入技术点与车型关联\n      const carModelAssocStats = await this.importTechPointCarModels();\n\n      // 7. 导入技术点与资源关联\n      const resourceAssocStats = await this.importTechPointResources();\n\n      // 输出汇总\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('数据导入完成');\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('品牌:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${brandStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${brandStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${brandStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术分类:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${categoryStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${categoryStats.skipped}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${categoryStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术点:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${techPointStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${techPointStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${techPointStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('车型:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${carModelStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${carModelStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${carModelStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('资源:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${resourceStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${resourceStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${resourceStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术点与车型关联:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${carModelAssocStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  跳过: ${carModelAssocStats.skipped}（技术点或车型不存在）&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${carModelAssocStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术点与资源关联:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${resourceAssocStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  跳过: ${resourceAssocStats.skipped}（技术点或资源不存在）&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${resourceAssocStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('========================================');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('导入过程发生错误:', error);\n      throw error;\n    } finally {\n      // 关闭数据库连接\n      await this.closeTPD2();\n      await this.targetDb.close();\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 主函数\nasync function main() {\n  // TPD2 数据库路径（可根据实际情况修改）\n  const tpd2DbPath = process.env.TPD2_DB_PATH || '/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/backend/data/todify2.db';\n\n  // 检查文件是否存在\n  if (!fs.existsSync(tpd2DbPath)) {\n    logger.error(&#96;❌ TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${tpd2DbPath}&#96;);\n    logger.info('请设置环境变量 TPD2_DB_PATH 指定正确的数据库路径');\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  logger.info(&#96;TPD2 数据库路径: ${tpd2DbPath}&#96;);\n\n  // 获取当前项目数据库配置\n  const config = getDatabaseConfig();\n  if (config.type === 'sqlite' &amp;&amp; config.sqlite) {\n    logger.info(&#96;目标数据库路径: ${config.sqlite.path}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const importer = new TPD2DataImporter(tpd2DbPath);\n    // 默认先清空本地数据，然后导入\n    await importer.import(true);\n    logger.info('✅ 数据导入成功完成');\n    process.exit(0);\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('❌ 数据导入失败:', error);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\n// 执行主函数\nif (require.main === module) {\n  main().catch((error) =&gt; countResult.length &gt; 0 ? countResult[0].count : 0;\n\n          if (count &gt; 0) {\n            logger.info(&#96;清空表 ${table}（${count} 条记录）...&#96;);\n            await this.targetDb.query(&#96;DELETE FROM ${table}&#96;);\n            logger.info(&#96;✅ 已清空表 ${table}&#96;);\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          logger.warn(&#96;清空表 ${table} 失败:&#96;, error?.message || error);\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info('✅ 本地数据清空完成');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('清空本地数据失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行完整导入流程\n   */\n  async import(clearFirst: boolean = true): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 连接数据库\n      await this.connectTPD2();\n      await this.targetDb.connect();\n\n      // 如果需要，先清空本地数据\n      if (clearFirst) {\n        await this.clearLocalData();\n      }\n\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('开始从 TPD2 导入数据');\n      logger.info('========================================');\n\n      // 1. 导入品牌（车型的前置依赖）\n      const brandStats = await this.importBrands();\n\n      // 2. 导入技术分类\n      const categoryStats = await this.importTechCategories();\n\n      // 3. 导入技术点\n      const techPointStats = await this.importTechPoints();\n\n      // 4. 导入车型（依赖品牌）\n      const carModelStats = await this.importCarModels();\n\n      // 5. 导入资源\n      const resourceStats = await this.importResources();\n\n      // 6. 导入技术点与车型关联\n      const carModelAssocStats = await this.importTechPointCarModels();\n\n      // 7. 导入技术点与资源关联\n      const resourceAssocStats = await this.importTechPointResources();\n\n      // 输出汇总\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('数据导入完成');\n      logger.info('========================================');\n      logger.info('品牌:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${brandStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${brandStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${brandStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术分类:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${categoryStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${categoryStats.skipped}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${categoryStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术点:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${techPointStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${techPointStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${techPointStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('车型:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${carModelStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${carModelStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${carModelStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('资源:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${resourceStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  更新: ${resourceStats.updated}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${resourceStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术点与车型关联:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${carModelAssocStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  跳过: ${carModelAssocStats.skipped}（技术点或车型不存在）&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${carModelAssocStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('技术点与资源关联:');\n      logger.info(&#96;  新增: ${resourceAssocStats.imported}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  跳过: ${resourceAssocStats.skipped}（技术点或资源不存在）&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  错误: ${resourceAssocStats.errors}&#96;);\n      logger.info('========================================');\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('导入过程发生错误:', error);\n      throw error;\n    } finally {\n      // 关闭数据库连接\n      await this.closeTPD2();\n      await this.targetDb.close();\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 主函数\nasync function main() {\n  // TPD2 数据库路径（可根据实际情况修改）\n  const tpd2DbPath = process.env.TPD2_DB_PATH || '/Volumes/Lexar/git/03T/TPD2/backend/data/todify2.db';\n\n  // 检查文件是否存在\n  if (!fs.existsSync(tpd2DbPath)) {\n    logger.error(&#96;❌ TPD2 数据库文件不存在: ${tpd2DbPath}&#96;);\n    logger.info('请设置环境变量 TPD2_DB_PATH 指定正确的数据库路径');\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  logger.info(&#96;TPD2 数据库路径: ${tpd2DbPath}&#96;);\n\n  // 获取当前项目数据库配置\n  const config = getDatabaseConfig();\n  if (config.type === 'sqlite' &amp;&amp; config.sqlite) {\n    logger.info(&#96;目标数据库路径: ${config.sqlite.path}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const importer = new TPD2DataImporter(tpd2DbPath);\n    // 默认先清空本地数据，然后导入\n    await importer.import(true);\n    logger.info('✅ 数据导入成功完成');\n    process.exit(0);\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('❌ 数据导入失败:', error);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\n// 执行主函数\nif (require.main === module) {\n  main().catch((error) =&gt; {\n    logger.error('未处理的错误:', error);\n    process.exit(1);\n  });\n}\n\nexport { TPD2DataImporter };\n",

}

        "contents": ");\n\n-- 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 知识使用日志表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_usage_logs (\n    ",

        "contents": "-- 三层级车系架构数据库迁移脚本 (SQLite版本)\n\n-- 1. 创建品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  logo_url TEXT,\n  country TEXT,\n  founded_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 创建更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS brands_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON brands\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE brands SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 3. 备份原有 car_models 表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models_backup AS SELECT * FROM car_models;\n\n-- 4. 从原有数据提取品牌信息并插入品牌表\nINSERT OR IGNORE INTO brands (name, status, created_at, updated_at)\nSELECT DISTINCT \n  brand,\n  'active',\n  datetime('now'),\n  datetime('now')\nFROM car_models\nWHERE brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != '';\n\n-- 5. 重命名原有 car_models 表为 car_series_temp\nALTER TABLE car_models RENAME TO car_series_temp;\n\n-- 6. 创建新的车型表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name_en TEXT,\n  category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n  launch_year INTEGER,\n  end_year INTEGER,\n  description TEXT,\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 7. 创建车型表更新时间触发器\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS car_models_updated_at \n  AFTER UPDATE ON car_models\n  FOR EACH ROW\n  BEGIN\n    UPDATE car_models SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n  END;\n\n-- 8. 创建车型表索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_car_models_brand_id ON car_models(brand_id);",

        "contents": "/**\n * AI问答服务\n */\nexport class AiSearchService {\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 创建AI问答对话表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_conversations (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT NOT NULL,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )\n      &#96;);\n      \n      // 如果表已存在但没有 page_type 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN page_type TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 page_type 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 如果表已存在但没有 dify_conversation_id 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN dify_conversation_id TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 dify_conversation_id 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 创建AI问答消息表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_messages (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')),\n          content TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT,\n          outputs TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_search_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n        )\n      &#96;);\n\n      // 创建输出内容表\n      await\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// PostgreSQL 连接管理\nclass PostgreSQLManager {\n  private pool: Pool | null = null;\n\n  constructor(config: any) {\n    this.pool = new Pool(config);\n  }\n\n  async connect(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      const client = await this.pool!.connect();\n      console.log('✅ PostgreSQL数据库连接成功');\n      client.release();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('❌ PostgreSQL连接失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async query(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    if (!this.pool) {\n      throw new Error('数据库未连接');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.pool.query(sql, params);\n      return result.rows;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('PostgreSQL查询错误:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async close(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    if (this.pool) {\n      await this.pool.end();\n      console.log('PostgreSQL数据库连接已关闭');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 数据库管理器\nexport class DatabaseManager {\n  private sqliteManager: SQLiteManager | null = null\n}",

        "contents": "# Todify3 数据库设计文档 v2.0\n\n## 一、概述\n\n本文档描述了 Todify3 项目的统一数据库架构设计，整合了所有分散的表定义，解决了表结构冲突，并规范化了命名和数据类型。\n\n### 1.1 设计目标\n\n- **统一管理**：所有表结构集中管理，易于维护\n- **性能优化**：优化索引和查询，提升数据库性能\n- **数据完整性**：完善外键约束，保障数据一致性\n- **可扩展性**：规范化设计，便于后续扩展\n- **向后兼容**：保持与现有代码的兼容性\n\n### 1.2 架构分层\n\n数据库架构分为五层：\n\n1. **第一层：基础数据层** - 品牌、车型、技术分类、技术点等核心业务数据\n2. **第二层：关联关系层** - 技术点与车型、知识点的关联关系\n3. **第三层：AI内容生成层** - 知识点、AI生成内容（包装材料、推广策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n4. **第四层：工作流与对话层** - Agent工作流、工作流执行、对话会话、聊天消息\n5. **第五层：配置与统计层** - AI角色配置、页面配置、文件管理、统计分析\n\n## 二、表结构设计\n\n### 2.1 第一层：基础数据层\n\n#### 2.1.1 品牌表 (brands)\n\n存储汽车品牌信息。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | TEXT | 品牌名称（唯一） |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| logo_url | TEXT | Logo URL |\n| country | TEXT | 国家 |\n| founded_year | INTEGER | 成立年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态：active/inactive |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.2 车型表 (car_models)\n\n存储车型信息，关联品牌。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| brand_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联brands.id |\n| name | TEXT | 车型名称 |\n| name_en | TEXT | 英文名称 |\n| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    logo_url TEXT,\n    country TEXT,\n    founded_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 车型表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 车系表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\n    description TEXT,\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\n);\n\n-- 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- 聊天消息相关数据库表结构\n-- 用于存储AI对话和Dify返回消息\n\n-- 1. 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    const dbType = this.db.getType();\n    \n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      // SQLite 表结构\n      const createCategoriesTableSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_knowledge_categories (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          parent_id INTEGER,\n          sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES public_knowledge_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n        );\n      &#96;;\n\n      const createFilesTableSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_knowledge_files (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          category_id INTEGER,\n          name TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          description TEXT,\n          uploaded_by INTEGER,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES public_knowledge_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n        );\n      &#96;;\n\n      const createIndexesSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_categories_parent_id ON public_knowledge_categories(parent_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_categories_sort_order ON public_knowledge_categories(sort_order);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category_id ON public_knowledge_files(category_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON public_knowledge_files(created_at);\n      &#96;;\n\n      try {\n        await this.db.query(createCategoriesTableSQL);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| avatar | TEXT | 头像URL |\n| system_prompt | TEXT | 系统提示词 |\n| dify_config | TEXT | JSON字符串，Dify配置 |\n| enabled | INTEGER | 是否启用（0/1） |\n| source | TEXT | 来源标记 |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\n\n**dify_config JSON结构**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"apiUrl\": \"string\",\n  \"apiKey\": \"string\",\n  \"connectionType\": \"chatflow\" | \"workflow\",\n  \"inputFields\": [...]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2.5.2 公开页面配置表 (public_page_configs)\n\n存储公开页面配置。\n\n#### 2.5.3 页面工具配置表 (page_tool_configs)\n\n存储页面工具配置，按页面类型唯一。\n\n#### 2.5.4 文件表 (files)\n\n存储上传的文件信息。\n\n#### 2.5.5 统计表\n\n- **workflow_node_usage** - 工作流节点使用统计\n- **ai_qa_feedback** - AI问答评价统计\n- **workflow_session_stats** - 工作流会话统计\n- **node_content_processing** - 节点内容处理统计\n- **workflow_stats_summary** - 实时统计汇总\n\n## 三、关键设计决策\n\n### 3.1 workflow_executions表统一\n\n**问题**：原有两个不同的&#96;workflow_executions&#96;表定义：\n1. Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）\n2. Dify工作流执行表（INTEGER主键，包含workflow_run_id、task_id等）\n\n**解决方案**：\n- 合并为统一表，使用TEXT主键\n- 添加&#96;execution_type&#96;字段区分类型\n- 包含两种类型的所有字段，根据类型使用相应字段\n\n### 3.2 主键类型规范\n\n- **核心业务表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT（brands, car_models, tech_points等）\n- **配置表**：使用TEXT（UUID或自定义ID）（ai_roles, agent_workflows等）\n- **关联表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT\n\n### 3.3 命名规范\n\n- **表名**：使用复数形式（tech_points而非tech_point）\n- **字段名**：统一使用snake_case\n- **索引名**：统一格式&#96;idx_表名_字段名&#96;\n\n### 3.4 JSON字段存储\n\n复杂配置数据以JSON字符串存储：\n- &#96;dify_config&#96; - Dify配置",

          {
            "text": "## 三、关键设计决策",

            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3.1 workflow_executions表统一",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "**问题**：原有两个不同的&#96;workflow_executions&#96;表定义：",

            "text": "1. Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）",

          },

            "text": "**解决方案**：",

            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "- 包含两种类型的所有字段，根据类型使用相应字段",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3.2 主键类型规范",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },

            "lineNumber": 289
          },

            "text": "- **核心业务表**：使用INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT（brands, car_models, tech_points等）",

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 293

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowModel {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建工作流执行表（统一结构，支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流）\n    // 注意：如果表已存在（通过迁移脚本创建），此CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS不会修改现有结构\n    const createExecutionTableSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\n        \n        -- Agent工作流执行字段\n        workflow_id TEXT,\n        workflow_name TEXT,\n        shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',\n        node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',\n        \n        -- Dify工作流执行字段\n        workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,\n        task_id TEXT,\n        message_id TEXT,\n        app_type TEXT,\n        \n        -- 通用执行字段\n        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\n        error_message TEXT,\n        inputs TEXT,\n        outputs TEXT,\n        \n        -- 执行统计\n        elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,\n        total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        duration INTEGER,\n        \n        -- 时间戳\n        start_time TIMESTAMP,\n        end_time TIMESTAMP,\n        started_at DATETIME,\n        finished_at DATETIME,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        \n        FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES agent_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n        FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(createExecutionTableSQL);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建workflow_executions表时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 如果表已存在但缺少新字段，尝试添加（向后兼容）\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "/**\n * 添加AI角色和工作流追踪字段的迁移脚本\n * 创建日期: 2025-11-01\n * 目的: 为统计表添加AI角色ID和工作流执行ID字段，建立关联关系\n */\n\nimport { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport * as fs from 'fs';\nimport * as path from 'path';\n\nconst db = new DatabaseManager();\n\n/**\n * 运行迁移脚本\n */\nasync function runMigration() {\n  try {\n    console.log('🚀 开始添加AI角色和工作流追踪字段...');\n    \n    // 确保数据库连接\n    await db.connect();\n    \n    // 检查ai_roles表是否存在\n    const checkAIRolesTable = &#96;\n      SELECT name FROM sqlite_master \n      WHERE type='table' AND name='ai_roles'\n    &#96;;\n    const aiRolesTableExists = await db.query(checkAIRolesTable);\n    \n    if (aiRolesTableExists.length === 0) {\n      console.warn('⚠️  ai_roles 表不存在，将仅添加字段，无法建立外键关联。');\n    }\n\n    // 检查workflow_executions表是否存在\n    const checkWorkflowExecTable = &#96;\n      SELECT name FROM sqlite_master \n      WHERE type='table' AND name='workflow_executions'\n    &#96;;\n    const workflowExecTableExists = await db.query(checkWorkflowExecTable);\n    \n    if (workflowExecTableExists.length === 0) {\n      console.warn('⚠️  workflow_executions 表不存在，将仅添加字段，无法建立外键关联。');\n    }\n\n    // 1. 为workflow_node_usage表添加字段\n    console.log('📝 步骤1: 为workflow_node_usage表添加字段...');\n    \n    // 检查ai_role_id字段是否已存在\n    const checkAIRoleIdColumn = &#96;\n      SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM pragma_table_info('workflow_node_usage') \n      WHERE name='ai_role_id'\n    &#96;;\n    const aiRoleIdExists = await db.query(checkAIRoleIdColumn);\n    \n    if (aiRoleIdExists[0]?.count === 0) {\n      await db.query('ALTER TABLE workflow_node_usage ADD COLUMN ai_role_id TEXT');\n      console.log('  ✅ 添加ai_role_id字段');\n    } else {\n      console.log('  ℹ️  ai_role_id字段已存在');\n    }\n\n    // 检查workflow_execution_id字段是否已存在\n}",

        "contents": "    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 3. 工作流执行记录表（用于技术包装等工作流应用）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify工作流运行ID\n    task_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 任务ID\n    message_id TEXT, -- 关联的消息ID\n    workflow_id TEXT, -- 工作流ID\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 应用类型\n    \n    -- 执行状态\n    status TEXT NOT NULL, -- 执行状态\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    \n    -- 输入输出\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入\n    outputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输出\n    \n    -- 执行统计\n    elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 执行时间（秒）\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 时间戳\n    started_at DATETIME, -- 开始时间\n    finished_at DATETIME, -- 完成时间\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 4. 知识点使用记录表（记录AI搜索中使用的知识点）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_usage_logs (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联的消息ID\n    knowledge_point_ids TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储使用的知识点ID\n    context_summary TEXT, -- JSON格式存储上下文摘要\n    context_length INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 上下文长度\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_conversation_id ON conversations(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_user_id ON conversations(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_app_type ON conversations(app_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_status ON conversations(status);",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

i &lt; lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i].trim();\n\n      if (line.includes('原理：')) {\n        result.principle = line.replace('原理：', '').trim();\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (line.includes('价值：')) {\n        result.value = line.replace('价值：', '').trim();\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (line.includes('适用边界：')) {\n        result.boundary = line.replace('适用边界：', '').trim();\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (line.includes('亮点：')) {\n        currentSection = 'highlights';\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (line.includes('实测：')) {\n        currentSection = 'evidenceMeasured';\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (line.includes('认证：')) {\n        currentSection = 'evidenceCertified';\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (line.includes('对比：')) {\n        currentSection = 'evidenceComparison';\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // 处理列表项\n      if (line.startsWith('- ')) {\n        const item = line.substring(2).trim();\n        if (currentSection === 'highlights' &amp;&amp; result.highlights.length &lt; 5) {\n          result.highlights.push(item);\n        } else if (currentSection === 'evidenceMeasured' &amp;&amp; result.evidenceMeasured.length &lt; 5) {\n          result.evidenceMeasured.push(item);\n        } else if (currentSection === 'evidenceCertified' &amp;&amp; result.evidenceCertified.length &lt; 5) {\n          result.evidenceCertified.push(item);\n        } else if (currentSection === 'evidenceComparison' &amp;&amp; result.evidenceComparison.length &lt; 5) {\n          result.evidenceComparison.push(item);\n        }\n        continue;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }, [currentTechPoint.description]);\n\n  const fetchAssociatedData = async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // 使用 Promise.allSettled 确保即使某个 API 失败，其他 API 也能继续执行\n      const [contentResult, carModelsResult] = await Promise.allSettled([\n        techPointService.getTechPointAssociatedContent(currentTechPoint.id),\n        techPointService.getTechPointAssociatedCarModels(currentTechPoint.id),\n      ]);\n\n      // 处理关联内容\n      if (contentResult.status === 'fulfilled' &amp;&amp; contentResult.value.success &amp;&amp; contentResult.value.data) {\n        const contentData = contentResult.value.data as AssociatedContent;\n        setAssociatedContent(contentData);\n        // 提取资源数据\n        if (contentData.resources) {\n          setAssociatedResources(contentData.resources);\n        }\n      } else {\n        // API 失败时设置为空数组，不影响组件渲染\n        setAssociatedContent({\n          packagingMaterials: [],\n          promotionStrategies: [],\n          pressReleases: [],\n          speeches: [],\n          resources: [],\n        });\n        setAssociatedResources([]);\n      }\n\n      // 处理关联车型\n      if (carModelsResult.status === 'fulfilled' &amp;&amp; carModelsResult.value.success &amp;&amp; carModelsResult.value.data) {\n        setAssociatedCarModels(carModelsResult.value.data);\n      } else {\n        // API 失败时设置为空数组，不影响组件渲染\n        setAssociatedCarModels([]);\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('获取关联数据失败:', err);\n      // 设置默认值，确保组件可以正常渲染\n      setAssociatedContent({\n        packagingMaterials: [],\n        promotionStrategies: [],\n        pressReleases: [],\n        speeches: [],\n        resources: [],\n      });\n      setAssociatedCarModels([]);\n      setAssociatedResources([]);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (dateString: string | undefined | null) =&gt; {\n    if (!dateString) return '未知';\n    try {\n      const date = dayjs(dateString);\n      if (!date.isValid()) return '未知';\n      return date.format('YYYY/MM/DD');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('日期格式化失败:', error);\n      return '未知';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =&gt; {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'active':\n        return 'success';\n      case 'inactive':\n        return 'default';\n      case 'draft':\n        return 'warning';\n      case 'archived':\n        return 'error';\n      default:\n        return 'default';",
  "totalLinesInFile": 982
}

   - 如果没有描述，显示“暂无描述”的空状态

3. **保持了数据完整性**：
   - `categoryName` 和 `technologyName` 仍保留在导出JSON功能中
   - 其他功能（知识点记录、关联车型、关联资源）保持不变

### 修改后的效果

现在“基本信息”Card 与TPD2项目完全一致：
- 只显示描述内容（`description` 字段）
- 使用相同的样式和布局
- 不再显示技术领域、技术IP、创建时间、更新时间等字段

请刷新浏览器查看效果。如果还有其他差异，请告知。
